document.title: bulbasaur — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: bulbasaur
ID: 1
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이상해씨
Name (en): Bulbasaur
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: green
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
Description (en, yellow): It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.
Description (en, gold): The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
Description (en, silver): It carries a seed on its back right from birth. As it grows older, the seed also grows larger.
Description (en, crystal): While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.
Description (en, ruby): BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
Description (en, firered): There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
Description (en, diamond): For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
Description (ko, x): 태어났을 때부터 등에 이상한 씨앗이 심어져 있으며 몸과 함께 자란다고 한다.
Description (en, x): A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
Description (ko, y): 태어나서부터 얼마 동안은 등의 씨앗으로부터 영양을 공급받아 크게 성장한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 양지에서 낮잠 자는 모습을 볼 수 있다. 태양의 빛을 많이 받으면 등의 씨앗이 크게 자란다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 며칠 동안 아무것도 먹지 않아도 건강하다! 등에 있는 씨앗에는 많은 영양분이 있어서 문제없다!
Description (ko, sword): 태어났을 때부터 등에 식물의 씨앗이 있으며 조금씩 크게 자란다.
Description (en, sword): There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
Description (ko, shield): 태어나서 얼마 동안 등의 씨앗에 담긴 영양을 섭취하며 자란다.
Description (en, shield): While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

document.title: ivysaur — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: ivysaur
ID: 2
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이상해풀
Name (en): Ivysaur
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: green
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
Description (en, yellow): The bulb on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
Description (en, gold): Exposure to sun­ light adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
Description (en, silver): If the bud on its back starts to smell sweet, it is evidence that the large flower will soon bloom.
Description (en, crystal): The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs nutrients. The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma when it blooms.
Description (en, ruby): There is a bud on this POKéMON’s back. To support its weight, IVYSAUR’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it’s a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
Description (en, emerald): To support its bulb, IVYSAUR’s legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.
Description (en, firered): There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
Description (en, diamond): When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
Description (en, heartgold): Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
Description (ko, x): 꽃봉오리가 등에 붙어 있으며 양분을 흡수해가면 커다란 꽃이 핀다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 등의 봉오리가 부풀어 오르면 달콤한 냄새가 감돌기 시작한다. 큰 꽃이 필 조짐이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 꽃봉오리를 지탱하기 위해 하반신이 강해진다. 양지에서 가만히 있는 시간이 길어지면 드디어 커다란 꽃이 필 때다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): There is a bud on this Pokémon’s back. To support its weight, Ivysaur’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it’s a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 양분을 흡수해서 커진 봉오리에서 향기가 나기 시작하면 곧 꽃이 핀다는 증거다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): The bud on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
Description (ko, sword): 등에 있는 봉오리가 크게 자라면 두 다리로 설 수 없게 되는 듯하다.
Description (ko, shield): 햇빛을 받을수록 몸에 힘이 솟아나 등의 꽃봉오리가 자라난다.

document.title: venusaur — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: venusaur
ID: 3
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 이상해꽃
Name (en): Venusaur
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: green
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
Description (en, yellow): The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
Description (en, gold): By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
Description (en, silver): It is able to con­ vert sunlight into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.
Description (en, crystal): As it warms it­ self and absorbs the sunlight, its flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.
Description (en, ruby): There is a large flower on VENUSAUR’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
Description (en, emerald): VENUSAUR’s flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
Description (en, firered): A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
Description (en, diamond): After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
Description (en, heartgold): By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
Description (en, soulsilver): It is able to convert sunlight into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.
Description (ko, x): 큰 꽃잎을 펼쳐 햇빛을 받고 있으면 몸에 힘이 넘쳐흐른다.
Description (ko, y): 비가 내린 다음 날은 등의 꽃향기가 강해진다. 향기에 이끌려 포켓몬이 모여든다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 충분한 영양분과 태양의 빛이 꽃의 색을 선명하게 만든다고 한다. 꽃의 향기는 사람의 마음을 치유한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): There is a large flower on Venusaur’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 등 위에 활짝 핀 큰 꽃은 태양 빛을 흡수해서 에너지로 변환할 수 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
Description (ko, sword): 태양에너지를 양분으로 큰 꽃을 피운다. 양지를 향해 이끌려가듯이 이동한다.
Description (ko, shield): 꽃에서 황홀한 향기가 퍼져 나와 싸우는 자의 기분을 달래준다.

document.title: charmander — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: charmander
ID: 4
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 파이리
Name (en): Charmander
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: red
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
Description (en, yellow): The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.
Description (en, gold): The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
Description (en, silver): The flame on its tail indicates CHARMANDER's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
Description (en, crystal): If it's healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigor­ ously, even if it gets a bit wet.
Description (en, ruby): The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
Description (en, emerald): The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
Description (en, firered): From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
Description (en, leafgreen): It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
Description (en, diamond): The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
Description (en, soulsilver): The flame on its tail indicates CHARMANDER’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리의 불꽃은 파이리의 생명력의 상징이다. 건강할 때 왕성하게 불타오른다.
Description (en, x): The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
Description (ko, y): 태어날 때부터 꼬리의 불꽃이 타오르고 있다. 불꽃이 꺼지면 그 생명이 다하고 만다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 꼬리의 불꽃은 기분을 표현한다. 즐거울 때는 흔들흔들 불꽃이 흔들리고 화가 났을 때는 활활 맹렬히 불타오른다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is enjoying itself. If the Pokémon becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 조용한 곳에 데려가면 꼬리가 타고 있는 작은 소리가 들린다.
Description (ko, sword): 뜨거운 것을 좋아하는 성격이다. 비에 젖으면 꼬리 끝에서 연기가 난다고 한다.
Description (ko, shield): 태어날 때부터 꼬리에 불꽃이 타오르고 있다. 불꽃이 꺼지면 생명도 다하고 만다.

document.title: charmeleon — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: charmeleon
ID: 5
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 리자드
Name (en): Charmeleon
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: red
shape: upright
Description (en, red): When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
Description (en, yellow): Tough fights could excite this POKéMON. When excited, it may blow out bluish- white flames.
Description (en, gold): It is very hot­ headed by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
Description (en, silver): It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.
Description (en, crystal): If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
Description (en, ruby): CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
Description (en, emerald): Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
Description (en, firered): It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
Description (en, leafgreen): When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.
Description (en, diamond): In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
Description (en, heartgold): It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
Description (en, black): In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리를 휘둘러 상대를 쓰러트리고 날카로운 발톱으로 갈기갈기 찢어버린다.
Description (ko, y): 불타는 꼬리를 휘두르면 주위의 온도가 점점 올라가 상대를 괴롭게 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 날카로운 발톱으로 봐주지 않고 때려눕힌다. 강한 적을 만나면 기분이 고양되며 꼬리의 불꽃이 푸르스름하게 불타오른다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Charmeleon mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 강한 적과 싸움을 거듭하다 흥분하면 푸르스름한 불꽃을 뿜어낼 때가 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may breathe out bluish-white flames.
Description (ko, sword): 불타는 꼬리를 휘두르며 날카로운 발톱으로 상대를 베어 가르는 몹시 거친 성격이다.
Description (ko, shield): 싸움으로 기분이 고조되면 작열하는 불꽃을 뿜으며 주변을 태워버린다.

document.title: charizard — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: charizard
ID: 6
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 리자몽
Name (en): Charizard
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: red
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
Description (en, yellow): When expelling a blast of super hot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
Description (en, gold): If CHARIZARD be­ comes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a whitish- blue color.
Description (en, silver): Breathing intense, hot flames, it can melt almost any­ thing. Its breath inflicts terrible pain on enemies.
Description (en, crystal): It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its fire increases as it gains exper­ ience in battle.
Description (en, ruby): CHARIZARD flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
Description (en, emerald): A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
Description (en, firered): Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
Description (en, leafgreen): It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
Description (en, diamond): It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
Description (en, heartgold): If CHARIZARD becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a light blue shade.
Description (en, soulsilver): Breathing intense, hot flames, it can melt almost anything. Its breath inflicts terrible pain on enemies.
Description (en, black): It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
Description (ko, x): 입에서 작렬하는 불꽃을 토해낼 때 꼬리의 끝이 더욱 붉고 격렬하게 타오른다.
Description (en, x): When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
Description (ko, y): 지상 1400m까지 날개를 사용해 날 수 있다. 고열의 불꽃을 내뿜는다.
Description (en, y): Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강한 상대를 찾아 하늘을 날아다닌다. 무엇이든 다 녹여버리는 고열의 불꽃을 자신보다 약한 자에게 들이대지 않는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): When this Pokémon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
Description (ko, sword): 암석도 태워버릴 정도로 작열하는 화염을 뿜어 산불을 일으킬 때가 있다.

document.title: squirtle — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: squirtle
ID: 7
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 꼬부기
Name (en): Squirtle
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: blue
shape: upright
Description (en, red): After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
Description (en, yellow): Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
Description (en, gold): The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prod­ ding fingers will bounce off it.
Description (en, silver): The shell, which hardens soon after it is born, is resilient. If you poke it, it will bounce back out.
Description (en, crystal): When it feels threatened, it draws its legs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
Description (en, ruby): SQUIRTLE’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this POKéMON to swim at high speeds.
Description (en, emerald): Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.
Description (en, firered): When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.
Description (en, leafgreen): After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
Description (en, diamond): It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
Description (en, heartgold): The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.
Description (en, black-2): It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
Description (ko, x): 등껍질에 숨어 몸을 보호한다. 상대의 빈틈을 놓치지 않고 물을 뿜어내어 반격한다.
Description (ko, y): 수면에서 물을 분사하여 먹이를 잡는다. 위험해지면 등껍질에 손발을 감추고 몸을 지킨다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 등껍질의 역할은 몸을 지키는 것뿐만이 아니다. 둥그런 모양과 표면의 홈이 물의 저항을 줄여서 빠르게 헤엄칠 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Squirtle’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this Pokémon to swim at high speeds.
Description (ko, sword): 기다란 목을 등껍질 속에 감춘 다음 기세 좋게 물대포를 발사한다.
Description (ko, shield): 위험해지면 등껍질에 손발을 감추고 몸을 지키면서 입에서 물을 내뿜는다.
Description (en, shield): When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

document.title: wartortle — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: wartortle
ID: 8
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 어니부기
Name (en): Wartortle
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: blue
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
Description (en, yellow): When tapped, this POKéMON will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
Description (en, gold): It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
Description (en, silver): It cleverly con­ trols its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
Description (en, crystal): Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, making it quite popular among older people.
Description (en, ruby): Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as WARTORTLE ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON’s toughness as a battler.
Description (en, emerald): Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON’s toughness in battle.
Description (en, firered): This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.
Description (en, leafgreen): It often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For fast swimming, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
Description (en, diamond): It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
Description (en, heartgold): It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
Description (en, soulsilver): It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
Description (ko, x): 딱 하고 머리를 맞을 때 등껍질로 숨어서 피한다. 하지만 꼬리가 살짝 삐져나와 있다.
Description (en, x): When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
Description (ko, y): 만 년의 수명을 가지고 있다고들 말한다. 치렁치렁한 꼬리는 장수의 상징으로서 인기가 있다.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Fearow is recognized by its long neck and elongated beak. They are conveniently shaped for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves its long and skinny beak to pluck prey.
Description (ko, sun): 터프하고 지구력도 우수하다. 무거운 짐을 진 채 온종일 날아도 끄떡없다.
Description (en, sun): It’s tough and has excellent stamina. It has no problem flying continuously for a whole day carrying a heavy load.
Description (ko, moon): 먼 태곳적 벽화 속에 깨비드릴조처럼 보이는 포켓몬이 그려져 있는 것이 발견되었다.
Description (en, moon): Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 깨비드릴조 영역에서 음식을 갖고 다니는 것은 위험하다. 순식간에 빼앗긴다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 알로라에서는 물고기포켓몬이 먹이다. 바다 위를 선회하며 먹이를 찾는 광경을 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): In Alola, fish Pokémon are its prey. It can be seen circling above the ocean searching for food.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 옛날부터 살고 있는 포켓몬. 조금이라도 위험을 감지하면 하늘 높이 날아가 버린다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

color: purple
shape: squiggle
Description (en, red): Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

Description (en, ruby): EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.
Description (en, emerald): An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.
Description (en, firered): A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.
Description (en, leafgreen): Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
Description (en, diamond): It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

Description (ko, x): 성장할수록 점점 길어진다. 밤에는 나뭇가지에 몸을 돌돌 말고 쉰다.
Description (ko, y): 전혀 기척을 느끼지 못하게 이동한다. 구구와 깨비참의 알을 통째로 삼켜버린다.
Description (en, y): Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as Pidgey and Spearow, whole.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 턱을 빼 자신보다 큰 먹이를 통째로 삼킨다. 식후에는 몸을 둥글게 하고 쉰다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 새포켓몬의 알을 좋아한다. 씹지 않고 통째로 삼키기 때문에 목이 막혀서 정신을 잃을 때도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

document.body:

generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: purple
shape: squiggle
Description (en, red): It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
Description (en, yellow): The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.
Description (en, gold): Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.
Description (en, silver): With a very venge­ ful nature, it won't give up the chase, no matter how far, once it targets its prey.
Description (en, crystal): To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.
Description (en, ruby): This POKéMON is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once ARBOK wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.
Description (en, emerald): This POKéMON has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.
Description (en, firered): The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
Description (en, diamond): The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
Description (en, soulsilver): With a very vengeful nature, it won’t give up the chase, no matter how far, once it targets its prey.
Description (ko, x): 배의 무늬가 무서운 얼굴로 보인다. 약한 적은 그 무늬만 보고도 도망치고 만다.
Description (ko, y): 가슴을 펴서 위협할 때 입에서 새는 공기 소리는 으스스해서 상대를 겁먹게 한다.

Description (en, ultra-sun): The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 배의 무늬로 풀이 죽게 한 뒤 재빠르게 몸으로 조여서 상대의 고동이 멈추기를 기다린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 무서워 보이는 배의 무늬는 연구 결과 6종류 정도의 패턴이 확인되었다.

document.title: pikachu — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: pikachu
ID: 25
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 피카츄
Name (en): Pikachu
generation: generation-i
habitat: forest
color: yellow
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
Description (en, yellow): It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.
Description (en, gold): This intelligent POKéMON roasts hard BERRIES with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
Description (en, silver): It raises its tail to check its sur­ roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light­ ning in this pose.
Description (en, crystal): When it is anger­ ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
Description (en, ruby): Whenever PIKACHU comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this POKéMON mistook the intensity of its charge.
Description (en, sapphire): This POKéMON has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while PIKACHU sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
Description (en, emerald): It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
Description (en, firered): It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
Description (en, leafgreen): When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
Description (en, diamond): It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
Description (en, pearl): If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.
Description (en, platinum): It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow PIKACHU that is in a weakened state.
Description (en, heartgold): This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
Description (en, soulsilver): It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
Description (en, black): It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
Description (ko, x): 꼬리를 세우고 주변의 상황을 살피다 보면 가끔 꼬리에 번개가 친다.
Description (ko, y): 뺨의 양쪽에 작은 전기 주머니가 있다. 위기 상황일 때 방전한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 처음 보는 것에게는 전격을 맞춘다. 새까맣게 탄 나무열매가 떨어져 있다는 것은 전격의 세기를 조절하지 못했다는 증거다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this Pokémon mistook the intensity of its charge.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 뺨의 전기 주머니에 있는 전기는 한밤중 자는 동안 축적되는 것 같다. 잠이 덜 깨서 방전하기도 한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): This Pokémon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
Description (ko, sun): 많은 피카츄를 모아서 발전소를 만들 계획이 최근 발표되었다.
Description (en, sun): A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
Description (ko, moon): 전기를 모으는 성질을 가졌다. 가끔 마음껏 방전하지 않으면 스트레스를 받는다.
Description (en, moon): It’s in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it’s unable to fully discharge the electricity.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 전기를 모으는 성질을 띠고 있다. 피카츄가 무리 지어 사는 숲은 낙뢰가 끊이지 않아 위험하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 자는 동안 볼의 주머니에서 전기를 만든다. 잠이 부족하면 약한 전기밖에 낼 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it’s not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 숲에 사는 포켓몬. 볼에 있는 주머니에 전기를 모으고 있어 만지면 저릿저릿 저리다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
Description (ko, sword): 만들어 내는 전기가 강력한 피카츄일수록 볼의 주머니가 부드럽고 잘 늘어난다.
Description (en, sword): Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
Description (ko, shield): 서로의 꼬리를 붙여서 전기를 흐르게 하는 게 피카츄 사이의 인사법이다.
Description (en, shield): When Pikachu meet, they’ll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

Description (en, red): Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
Description (en, yellow): When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
Description (en, gold): When its electric­ ity builds, its muscles are stimu­ lated, and it be­ comes more aggres­ sive than usual.
Description (en, silver): If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.
Description (en, crystal): If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electri­ city from the atmosphere.
Description (en, ruby): If the electrical sacks become excessively charged, RAICHU plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this POKéMON’s nest.
Description (en, sapphire): This POKéMON exudes a weak electrical charge from all over its body that makes it take on a slight glow in darkness. RAICHU searches for electricity by planting its tail in the ground.
Description (en, emerald): If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.
Description (en, firered): Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
Description (en, diamond): It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.
Description (en, pearl): It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.
Description (en, platinum): Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
Description (en, heartgold): When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
Description (ko, x): 전기가 모이면 근육이 자극되어 여느 때보다 공격적이 된다.
Description (ko, y): 전기의 충격은 10만 볼트다. 자신보다 몇 배나 큰 상대를 일격에 기절시킨다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 전기 주머니에 전기가 넘칠 정도로 차면 꼬리를 땅에 닿게 하여 방전한다. 사는 곳 근처의 땅에는 탄 흔적이 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): If the electrical sacs become excessively charged, Raichu plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this Pokémon’s nest.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 약한 전기를 온몸에서 발산하고 있기 때문에 어두운 곳에서는 희미하게 빛난다. 꼬리를 땅에 박고 전기를 흘려보낸다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): This Pokémon exudes a weak electrical charge from all over its body that makes it take on a slight glow in darkness. Raichu plants its tail in the ground to discharge electricity.
Description (ko, sun): 전격은 10만볼트에 이르기도 해서 잘못 만지면 인도코끼리라도 기절한다.
Description (en, sun): It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.
Description (ko, moon): 전기가 모이면 성질이 거칠어진다. 트레이너라도 주의하지 않으면 공격당한다.
Description (en, moon): It becomes aggressive when it has electricity stored up. At such times, even its Trainer has to take care to avoid being attacked.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 몸에 전기가 쌓일수록 공격적으로 변한다. 사실은 전기가 스트레스라는 설도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 피카츄의 모습을 좋아하는 트레이너도 많아서 좀처럼 모습을 보기 힘든 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Because so many Trainers like the way Pikachu looks, you don’t see this Pokémon very often.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 몸에 전기가 모이면 공격적인 성격으로 변한다. 어두운 곳에서 빛나 보인다.
Description (ko, sword): 긴 꼬리가 어스가 되어 몸을 지키기 때문에 자신은 고전압에도 마비되지 않는다.
Description (ko, shield): 전기 주머니가 텅 비면 꼬리를 똑바로 세워서 공기 중의 전기를 모은다.
Description (en, shield): If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

document.title: sandshrew — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: sandshrew
ID: 27
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 모래두지
Name (en): Sandshrew
generation: generation-i
habitat: rough-terrain
color: yellow
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
Description (en, yellow): Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
Description (en, gold): If it fell from a great height, this POKéMON could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
Description (en, silver): Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.
Description (en, crystal): It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses the sand to protect itself when threatened.
Description (en, ruby): SANDSHREW’s body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This POKéMON curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
Description (en, sapphire): SANDSHREW has a very dry hide that is extremely tough. The POKéMON can roll into a ball that repels any attack. At night, it burrows into the desert sand to sleep.
Description (en, emerald): When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.
Description (en, firered): It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
Description (en, leafgreen): Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for prey.
Description (en, diamond): To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
Description (en, heartgold): If it fell from a great height, this Pokémon could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
Description (en, black-2): It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.
Description (ko, x): 지면에 구멍을 파고 산다. 자신에게 위험이 닥쳐오면 둥글게 말아서 몸을 보호한다.
Description (ko, y): 습기를 싫어해서 건조한 땅에 깊은 구멍을 파고 생활한다. 눈 깜짝할 사이에 몸을 둥글게 만다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸이 수분을 효율적으로 흡수하기 때문에 건조한 모래땅에서도 문제없다. 몸을 둥글게 만들어 적의 공격을 막는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Sandshrew’s body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This Pokémon curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 바싹바싹 마른 피부는 매우 단단해서 몸을 둥글게 말면 어떤 공격도 튕겨낸다. 밤에는 사막의 모래에 들어가 잠잔다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Sandshrew has a very dry hide that is extremely tough. The Pokémon can roll into a ball that repels any attack. At night, it burrows into the desert sand to sleep.
Description (ko, sun): 몸을 웅크려서 공 같은 모습이 된다. 구르면서 사막을 고속으로 이동한다.
Description (en, sun): It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through the desert by rolling at high speeds.
Description (ko, moon): 비가 내리지 않는 건조지대나 사막이 주된 거처다. 구멍을 파서 벌레포켓몬을 잡는다.

Description (en, sword): The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.
Description (ko, shield): 날카로운 발톱으로 찍으며 나무에 오른다. 아래에서 기다리는 모래두지들에게 나무열매를 떨어뜨려 나눠준다.

Description (en, silver): Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can snap the victim's spine quite easily.
Description (en, crystal): It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Nidoking’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: clefairy
ID: 35
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 삐삐
Name (en): Clefairy
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: pink
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
Description (en, yellow): Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.
Description (en, gold): The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
Description (en, silver): Its adorable be­ havior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute POKéMON is rarely found.
Description (en, crystal): Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot, for some reason, on the night of a full moon.
Description (en, ruby): On every night of a full moon, groups of this POKéMON come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
Description (en, emerald): On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.
Description (en, firered): Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.
Description (en, leafgreen): With its magical and cute appeal, it has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
Description (en, diamond): Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
Description (en, pearl): It flies using the wings on its back to collect moonlight. This Pokémon is difficult to find.
Description (en, platinum): It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of CLEFAIRY dancing under a full moon.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.
Description (en, black): It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
Description (en, black-2): On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.
Description (ko, x): 보름달 밤에 삐삐가 모여 춤을 추는 모습을 보면 행복해진다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, y): 등의 날개에 달빛을 모으면 공중에 떠오를 수 있다는 듯하다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 보름달 밤에는 기운차게 논다. 동틀 녘에 지친 삐삐들은 조용한 산속에서 동료와 바짝 붙어 잠잔다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): On every night of a full moon, groups of this Pokémon come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
Description (ko, sun): 사랑스러운 몸짓과 모습으로 남녀노소 가리지 않고 인기가 있지만, 그 수는 적다.
Description (en, sun): Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.
Description (ko, moon): 보름달 밤에 모여서 동료와 춤을 춘다. 그 주변은 이상한 자기장으로 둘러싸인다.
Description (en, moon): On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 인기가 있지만, 개체 수가 적어 귀하다. 함부로 자랑하다가는 도둑의 타깃이 된다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): They’re popular, but they’re rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 달빛에 비친 날개는 희미하게 빛나고 날갯짓하지 않아도 허공을 떠다니며 춤을 춘다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Bathed in moonlight, its wings glow faintly. Without even flapping, Clefairy rises into the air, where it dances around.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 모습과 행동이 사랑스러워서 인기가 높지만 수가 적어서인지 좀처럼 발견되지 않는다.
Description (ko, shield): 애교 있는 몸동작과 울음소리로 귀엽다고 많은 인기를 누리는 포켓몬. 그러나 좀처럼 눈에 띄지 않는다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

document.body:

Name: clefable
ID: 36
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 픽시
Name (en): Clefable
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: pink
shape: upright
Description (en, red): A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
Description (en, yellow): They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.
Description (en, gold): With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
Description (en, silver): Its very sensitive ears lets it dis­ tinguish distant sounds. As a re­ sult, it prefers quiet places.
Description (en, crystal): Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.
Description (en, ruby): CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
Description (en, emerald): A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
Description (en, firered): It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
Description (en, leafgreen): A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
Description (en, diamond): Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
Description (en, pearl): Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.
Description (en, platinum): It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its very sensitive ears let it distinguish distant sounds. As a result, it prefers quiet places.
Description (en, black-2): Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they’re usually found in quiet places.
Description (ko, x): 1km 전방에 떨어진 바늘 소리도 분간할 수 있는 우수한 귀를 가지고 있다. 조용한 산속에 살고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 요정의 동료로 좀처럼 사람 앞에 나타나지 않는다. 기척을 느끼면 바로 도망가는 듯하다.
Description (en, y): A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 날개를 사용하여 날아가듯 뛰어간다. 물 위를 걷는 것도 할 수 있다. 조용한 달밤에 호수를 걷는다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Clefable moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
Description (ko, sun): 사람 앞에 모습을 보이는 것을 좋아하지 않는다. 깊은 산 속에서 무리를 지어 조용히 살고 있다.
Description (en, sun): They don’t like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.
Description (ko, moon): 한 쌍의 픽시가 뛰어가는 모습을 보면 행복한 결혼을 할 수 있다고 전해진다.
Description (en, moon): According to tradition, people who see a pair of Clefable skipping by can look forward to a happy marriage.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 1km 떨어진 곳에서 바늘이 떨어지는 소리도 들을 수 있어 사람과 포켓몬이 적은 깊은 산속에 산다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It can’t help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren’t many people or Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 보름달이 뜨는 밤에 밤하늘을 바라보는 이유는 향수병 때문이라고 생각하는 과학자도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Some scientists believe that it gazes intently at the sky on nights with a full moon because it’s homesick.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 자신들의 세계를 소중히 생각하고 있는 듯 좀처럼 사람 앞에 나타나지 않는 요정의 일종.
Description (ko, shield): 1km 앞에 떨어진 바늘 소리가 들릴 정도로 귀가 좋아 평소에는 조용한 곳에서 지낸다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: vulpix
ID: 37
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 식스테일
Name (en): Vulpix
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: brown
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
Description (en, yellow): Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
Description (en, gold): As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
Description (en, silver): If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.
Description (en, crystal): As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxur­ ious coat of fur.
Description (en, ruby): At the time of its birth, VULPIX has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this POKéMON receives plenty of love from its TRAINER. The six tails become magnificently curled.
Description (en, sapphire): Inside VULPIX’s body burns a flame that never goes out. During the daytime, when the temperatures rise, this POKéMON releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.
Description (en, emerald): It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o’-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.
Description (en, firered): While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
Description (en, leafgreen): When it is born, it has just one snow- white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
Description (en, diamond): It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
Description (en, black-2): As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.
Description (ko, x): 태어났을 때는 꼬리가 새하얗고 하나밖에 없다. 성장하면 끝이 갈라지며 꼬리 수가 늘어난다.
Description (en, x): When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
Description (ko, y): 어리지만 6개의 꼬리가 아름답다. 성장하면 한층 꼬리 수가 늘어난다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 태어났을 때는 하얀 꼬리가 한 개다. 애정을 많이 받으면 꼬리가 6개로 나뉘며 멋지게 말린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): At the time of its birth, Vulpix has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this Pokémon receives plenty of love from its Trainer. The six tails become magnificently curled.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 몸 안에서 항상 불꽃이 타고 있다. 낮에 기온이 올라가면 체온도 올라가기 때문에 입으로 불꽃을 빼낸다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Inside Vulpix’s body burns a flame that never goes out. During the daytime, when the temperatures rise, this Pokémon releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.
Description (ko, sun): 털과 꼬리가 아름다워서 인기가 많다. 성장함에 따라 꼬리가 나뉘면서 늘어난다.
Description (en, sun): Its beautiful fur and tails have made it very popular. As it grows, its tails split to form more tails.
Description (ko, moon): 입에서 도깨비불 같은 불꽃을 내뱉어서 유령으로 착각하는 사람도 있다.
Description (en, moon): From its mouth spew flames that seem to resemble the spirits of the deceased. Some people mistakenly think this fire is a ghost.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 아름다운 꼬리 때문에 인기가 많다. 단 바지런히 빗질을 하지 않으면 순식간에 헝클어진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it’s not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 불구슬을 조종하여 먹이를 잡는다. 어릴 때부터 키우면 강아지포켓몬처럼 따른다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It manipulates balls of fire to catch its prey. If you raise one from when it’s young, it will grow close to you like a puppy Pokémon.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 털과 꼬리가 아름답다. 성장하면 꼬리 끝이 갈라져서 갈래가 많아진다.
Description (ko, shield): 6개의 꼬리는 자라면서 털의 결이 좋아지며 아름다워진다. 안으면 살짝 따듯하다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: yellow
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
Description (en, yellow): According to an enduring legend, 9 noble saints were united and reincarnated as this POKéMON.
Description (en, gold): Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
Description (en, silver): Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.
Description (en, crystal): It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
Description (en, ruby): NINETALES casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This POKéMON is said to live for a thousand years.
Description (en, sapphire): Legend has it that NINETALES came into being when nine wizards possessing sacred powers merged into one. This POKéMON is highly intelligent - it can understand human speech.
Description (en, emerald): It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that shines like gold.
Description (en, firered): It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
Description (en, leafgreen): Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
Description (en, diamond): Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
Description (en, black-2): Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.
Description (ko, x): 황금빛으로 빛나는 털과 9개의 긴 꼬리를 지녔다. 1000년을 산다고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 머리가 좋고 집념이 강하다. 장난으로 꼬리를 잡으면 1000년 동안 화를 입는다고 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 새빨간 눈은 괴상한 빛을 발산하여 상대의 마음을 자유로이 조종한다. 1000년을 산다고 전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Ninetales casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This Pokémon is said to live for a thousand years.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 성스러운 힘을 지닌 9명의 신선이 합체하여 태어났다는 전설이 있다. 지능이 높아서 사람의 말을 이해한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Legend has it that Ninetales came into being when nine wizards possessing sacred powers merged into one. This Pokémon is highly intelligent—it can understand human speech.
Description (ko, sun): 9명의 성자가 합체하여 나인테일이 되었다는 전설이 남을 정도로 신비함이 가득한 포켓몬.
Description (en, sun): Legend has it that this mystical Pokémon was formed when nine saints coalesced into one.
Description (ko, moon): 1000년을 산다고 전해진다. 신통력으로 화염을 자유자재로 조종해서 먹이를 불태워버린다.
Description (en, moon): Said to live for a thousand years, this Pokémon uses its supernatural abilities to manipulate fire. It can burn its prey to a crisp as it pleases.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 끈질기고 집념이 강한 성질을 가졌다. 한 번 원한을 사면 자손을 포함해 1000년간 해를 입는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 입에서 흔들리는 불꽃을 뿜어서 최면 상태로 만든 후에 먹이를 덮치는 매우 똑똑한 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The flickering flames it spews from its mouth leave its opponents hypnotized. Then, this extremely intelligent Pokémon attacks.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 9명의 성자가 합체하여 이 포켓몬으로 다시 태어났다는 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokémon.
Description (ko, sword): 꼬리 하나하나에 신통력이 담겨 있다. 1000년을 산다고 한다.
Description (en, sword): It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

document.title: jigglypuff — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:

Name: jigglypuff
ID: 39
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 푸린
Name (en): Jigglypuff
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: pink
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
Description (en, yellow): Uses its alluring eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
Description (en, gold): If it inflates to SING a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
Description (en, silver): Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.
Description (en, crystal): It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.
Description (en, ruby): JIGGLYPUFF’s vocal chords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This POKéMON uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
Description (en, sapphire): When this POKéMON sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, JIGGLYPUFF cannot breathe, endangering its life.
Description (en, emerald): Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF’s song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.
Description (en, firered): It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
Description (en, leafgreen): When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
Description (en, diamond): When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
Description (en, heartgold): If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
Description (en, black-2): Looking into its cute, round eyes makes it start singing a song so pleasant listeners can’t help but fall asleep.

Description (ko, y): 크게 몸을 부풀려 노래하는 자장가는 평소보다 길어서 반드시 잠이 온다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 목소리의 파장을 자유로이 바꿀 수 있는 성대가 있어서 상대가 가장 졸리게 되는 파장으로 노래를 부를 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Jigglypuff’s vocal cords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This Pokémon uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 노래할 때는 한 번도 숨을 쉬지 않는다. 어지간히 잠들지 않는 상대와 맞설 때는 숨을 쉴 수 없기에 푸린도 필사적이다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When this Pokémon sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, Jigglypuff cannot breathe, endangering its life.
Description (ko, sun): 배를 크게 부풀려서 신비한 멜로디를 노래한다. 들으면 바로 졸음이 쏟아진다.
Description (en, sun): It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.
Description (ko, moon): 12옥타브를 넘는 음역을 지녔지만 노래를 잘하는지는 푸린 저마다의 노력에 달렸다.
Description (en, moon): Jigglypuff possess a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual’s singing skill depends on its own effort.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 백화점 침구 코너에는 푸린의 신비한 자장가를 수록한 CD를 판매하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Recordings of Jigglypuff’s strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 부르는 노래는 서식하는 지방에 따라 전혀 다르다. 그중에는 샤우팅하는 듯한 노래도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they’re shouting!
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 초롱초롱한 눈동자로 상대를 바라본 다음 이상하고 기분 좋은 노래를 불러서 잠들게 한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
Description (ko, sword): 폐활량은 포켓몬 중에서도 톱클래스다. 상대가 잠들 때까지 자장가를 계속 부른다.
Description (en, sword): Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.
Description (ko, shield): 목소리 파장을 자유자재로 바꾸어 들으면 반드시 잠드는 신비한 멜로디를 노래한다.
Description (en, shield): By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

Description (en, leafgreen): It forms colonies in perpetually dark places and uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Zubat remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.

Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Zubat avoids sunlight because exposure causes it to become unhealthy. During the daytime, it stays in caves or under the eaves of old houses, sleeping while hanging upside down.
Description (ko, sun): 낮에는 동굴에서 자고 있다. 눈이 없어서 초음파로 주변을 확인하면서 날아다닌다.

Description (en, ultra-sun): It has no eyeballs, so it can’t see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 햇빛을 받으면 화상을 입을 정도로 피부가 얇다. 추워지면 무리 지어 서로 몸을 기대서 체온을 나눈다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Their skin is so thin that they’ll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another’s bodies.

Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.
Description (ko, sword): 입에서 내보내는 초음파로 주위의 상황을 살핀다. 좁은 동굴에서도 능숙하게 날아다닌다.
Description (en, sword): It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
Description (ko, shield): 볕이 들지 않는 동굴에 산다. 아침이 되면 동료들끼리 모여 서로의 온기를 나누면서 잔다.
Description (en, shield): Zubat live in caves, down where the sun’s light won’t reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

Description (en, sapphire): PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this BUG POKéMON host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.

Description (en, moon): Mushrooms called tochukaso sprout from its back. They can be dried and powdered to make a medicine used to extend life.

Description (ko, x): 지하 1m 정도를 파고들어 가서 나무뿌리 등을 씹어 먹고 산다. 가끔 지상으로 얼굴을 내민다.
Description (ko, y): 피부가 매우 얇아서 빛을 쪼이게 되면 혈액이 데워져 약해진다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 농가 대부분이 디그다를 기르고 있다. 디그다가 구멍을 판 땅은 적당히 일궈져 있어 맛있는 채소가 재배되기 때문이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple— wherever this Pokémon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
Description (ko, sun): 지하에서 나무뿌리를 갉아먹는다. 키우는 채소의 품종에 따라서는 농가에 해를 끼치는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, sun): It chews on plant roots underground. Farmers whose vegetables are vulnerable find it can be quite a pest.
Description (ko, moon): 디그다가 사는 땅은 일궈져 있으며 배설물로 비옥해져서 많은 농가에서 소중히 기르고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Many farmers cherish and nurture Diglett because its droppings enrich the soil it lives in.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 지하에 터널을 파서 이동한다. 빛을 싫어해서 해가 진 후에 지상으로 나온다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 농가에서는 작물 주변에 디그다가 좋아하는 나무를 심어서 땅을 일구게 하고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Around their crops, farmers plant the kind of tree that Diglett like to eat as a way of getting Diglett to plow the fields for them.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 어두운 곳을 좋아한다. 거의 땅속에서 지내지만 동굴에서는 자주 얼굴을 내밀고 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 디그다가 지나간 뒤의 대지는 알맞게 땅이 일궈져 최고의 밭이 된다.
Description (en, sword): If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
Description (ko, shield): 얕은 땅속을 이동한다. 굴을 파며 다닌 곳은 지면이 솟아 있기 때문에 바로 알 수 있다.

document.title: dugtrio — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: dugtrio
ID: 51
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 닥트리오
Name (en): Dugtrio
generation: generation-i
habitat: cave
color: brown
shape: heads
Description (en, red): A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
Description (en, yellow): A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it's an earthquake.
Description (en, gold): Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
Description (en, silver): Extremely power­ ful, they can DIG through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.
Description (en, crystal): These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
Description (en, ruby): DUGTRIO are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
Description (en, emerald): Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.
Description (en, firered): In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
Description (en, diamond): Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
Description (en, soulsilver): Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.
Description (ko, x): 땅속을 파고들어 가 상대가 방심하고 있을 때 다른 곳에서 공격한다.
Description (ko, y): 엄청난 힘의 소유자로 그 어떤 단단한 땅이라도 지하 100km까지 파고들어 간다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 본래 하나의 몸에서 세쌍둥이가 된 것이라 모두 생각하는 것이 같다. 힘을 모아 끝없이 파나간다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
Description (ko, sun): 세쌍둥이가 협력해서 행동한다. 지하 100km를 파고 갈 정도의 파워는 팀워크 덕택이다.
Description (en, sun): This set of triplets moves cooperatively. It’s the power of teamwork that enables this Pokémon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.
Description (ko, moon): 농가 등 많은 사람에게 친숙하지만 땅 아래의 모습을 본 사람은 없다.
Description (en, moon): Despite the closeness between this Pokémon and farmers and other people, no one has ever seen the parts of it concealed underground.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 언제나 사이좋은 세쌍둥이지만 극히 드물게 어느 머리가 먼저 먹이를 먹을까로 큰 싸움을 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 매끄러운 형태를 하고 있지만 굉장히 머리가 단단하다. 어떤 지반이라도 박치기로 파고 간다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Dugtrio’s heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 세쌍둥이의 파워로 지하 100km까지 땅을 파고들어 간다. 이것이 지진의 원인이라는 보고도 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.
Description (ko, sword): 팀워크가 뛰어난 세쌍둥이 디그다. 지하 100km까지 파고들어 지진을 일으킬 때도 있다.
Description (en, sword): A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
Description (ko, shield): 지하 100km까지 파고들 수 있는 파워를 간직한 세쌍둥이 디그다. 땅 밑은 아무도 모른다.
Description (en, shield): These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

document.title: meowth — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: meowth
ID: 52
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 나옹
Name (en): Meowth
generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: yellow
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
Description (en, yellow): Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop from picking them up.
Description (en, gold): It is fascinated by round objects. It can't stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
Description (en, silver): It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and se­ cretly hoards.
Description (en, crystal): It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.
Description (en, ruby): MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
Description (en, emerald): MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
Description (en, firered): All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
Description (en, leafgreen): Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
Description (en, diamond): It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
Description (en, heartgold): It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
Description (en, soulsilver): It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.
Description (ko, x): 한밤중에 움직이는 습성이 있다. 반짝반짝 빛나는 것을 발견하면 그에 못지않게 눈동자가 반짝인다.
Description (ko, y): 둥근 물건을 정말 좋아한다. 밤마다 나가서는 떨어진 동전을 주워 모아서 돌아온다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 날카로운 발톱을 집어넣고 살금살금 발소리를 내지 않고 걸을 수 있다. 반짝반짝 빛나는 동전을 왠지 모르지만 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
Description (ko, sun): 낮에는 느긋하게 자면서 지내고 해가 떨어지면 활동을 시작한다. 밤이 되면 거리에서 동전을 찾는다.
Description (en, sun): It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
Description (ko, moon): 반짝이는 물건을 매우 좋아한다. 자주 니로우와 먹이를 서로 빼앗으며 싸우고 있다.
Description (en, moon): It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they’re both trying to catch.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 쓰레기장에 가면 빛이 나는 물건을 두고 니로우와 격렬하게 싸우는 광경을 볼 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 동전을 매우 좋아한다. 동전을 주면 쉽게 친해지지만 변덕스럽기 때문에 그다지 믿을 게 못 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it’s fickle, so you can’t count on that friendship lasting.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 밤에 더 기운이 넘치는 것 같다. 둥글고 빛나는 것을 좋아해서 발견하면 줍지 않고는 못 배긴다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.
Description (ko, sword): 빛나는 물건을 모으는 것을 좋아한다. 기분이 좋을 때는 트레이너에게도 컬렉션을 보여준다.
Description (en, sword): It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
Description (ko, shield): 이마의 금화가 더러워지지 않도록 바지런히 얼굴을 씻는다. 가라르의 나옹과는 사이가 나쁘다.
Description (en, shield): It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

document.title: persian — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: persian
ID: 53
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 페르시온
Name (en): Persian
generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: yellow
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
Description (en, yellow): The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
Description (en, gold): Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
Description (en, silver): Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.
Description (en, crystal): Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.
Description (en, ruby): PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the POKéMON’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
Description (en, emerald): A PERSIAN’s six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
Description (en, firered): Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
Description (en, diamond): A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
Description (ko, x): 털의 결이 아름다워 애완용으로 기르려는 사람이 많지만, 곧잘 할퀴려 들기 때문에 쉽지 않다.
Description (ko, y): 부드러운 근육 덕분에 발소리를 내지 않고 걸을 수 있다. 먹이를 사냥할 때는 순식간이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 튼튼한 6가닥의 수염은 공기의 움직임으로 주변의 상태를 파악하는 역할을 한다. 수염을 잡히면 얌전해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokémon’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
Description (ko, sun): 기질이 거칠어 눈이 마주치는 것만으로 덤벼든다. 날카로운 발톱으로 공격당하면 깊은 상처를 입는다.
Description (en, sun): It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.
Description (ko, moon): 알로라의 페르시온 정도는 아니지만 자존심이 강하기 때문에 길들이기가 꽤 어렵다.
Description (en, moon): It has a high opinion of itself, although not to the same extent as the Alolan Persian. It’s quite difficult to make friends with this Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 알로라의 페르시온과는 이마의 보석 색깔이 다르지만, 성분은 크게 다르지 않다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it’s mostly made of the same material.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 부자들에게 인기가 많은 포켓몬이다. 이마에 박힌 보석 때문에 사냥꾼들이 노리는 경우도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): This Pokémon is popular with rich people. It’s also targeted by hunters who are after the jewel in its forehead.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 이마의 보석이 빛난다! 걷는 모습도 우아하고 왕녀와 같은 화려함이 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 자존심이 세서 길들이기 힘들다. 마음에 들지 않는 일이 있으면 바로 발톱을 세운다.
Description (en, sword): Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.
Description (ko, shield): 움직임은 우아하고 품위 있다. 야만스러운 나이킹과는 잘 맞지 않아 서로를 멸시한다.
Description (en, shield): Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

document.title: psyduck — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: psyduck
ID: 54
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고라파덕
Name (en): Psyduck
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: yellow
shape: upright
Description (en, red): While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
Description (en, yellow): Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but it is not known if it intends to do so.
Description (en, gold): It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
Description (en, silver): If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.
Description (en, crystal): The only time it can use its psy­ chic power is when its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.
Description (en, ruby): PSYDUCK uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this POKéMON generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
Description (en, sapphire): If it uses its mysterious power, PSYDUCK can’t remember having done so. It apparently can’t form a memory of such an event because it goes into an altered state that is much like deep sleep.
Description (en, emerald): When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.
Description (en, firered): It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
Description (en, diamond): If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
Description (en, pearl): It never remembers using its odd powers, so it always tilts its head in puzzlement.
Description (en, platinum): Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
Description (en, heartgold): It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
Description (en, black-2): When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.
Description (ko, x): 항상 두통에 시달리고 있다. 이 두통이 심해지면 이상한 힘을 쓰기 시작한다.
Description (ko, y): 이상한 힘을 간직하고 있지만 사용했던 기억이 없으므로 항상 고개를 갸웃거리고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 이상한 힘을 발휘하는 고라파덕에게서 잠들어 있을 때만 발산되는 뇌파가 관측되어 학회에서 화제가 되었다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Psyduck uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this Pokémon generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 이상한 힘을 썼던 기억이 없는 것은 힘을 발휘할 때가 숙면 중일 때와 같은 상태이기 때문인 것 같다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): If it uses its mysterious power, Psyduck can’t remember having done so. It apparently can’t form a memory of such an event because it goes into an altered state that is much like deep sleep.
Description (ko, sun): 가끔 자신의 의지와 상관없이 염동력이 나와버린다. 그 때문에 머리가 아파서 울곤 한다.
Description (en, sun): As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.
Description (ko, moon): 언제나 두통에 시달리고 있다. 고통이 심할 때 일수록 강력한 염동력을 발산한다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon is troubled by constant headaches. The more pain it’s in, the more powerful its psychokinesis becomes.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 염동력을 사용하면 두통이 생겨서 평소에는 아무것도 하지 않고 가능한 멍하니 지낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 두통이 발생하는 동안 뇌세포가 평소의 10배나 활동한다는 사실이 밝혀졌다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 항상 두통에 시달리고 있다. 염력을 사용하지만 자신의 의지인지 아닌지 알 수 없다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.
Description (ko, sword): 언제나 두통에 시달린다. 신비한 힘을 폭발시키면 잠시 통증이 진정되는 듯하다.
Description (en, sword): Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If the Pokémon lets its strange power erupt, apparently the pain subsides for a while.
Description (ko, shield): 스트레스가 쌓이면 두통이 심해진다. 강력한 염동력으로 주위를 압도한다.
Description (en, shield): As Psyduck gets stressed out, its headache gets progressively worse. It uses intense psychic energy to overwhelm those around it.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
