document.title: golduck — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: golduck
ID: 55
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 골덕
Name (en): Golduck
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: blue
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
Description (en, yellow): Its slim and long limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swim­ ming gracefully in lakes.
Description (en, gold): When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its fore­ head somehow be­ gins to glow.
Description (en, silver): It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use tele­ kinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
Description (en, crystal): It swims grace­ fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.
Description (en, ruby): The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of GOLDUCK give it frightening speed. This POKéMON is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
Description (en, sapphire): GOLDUCK is the fastest swimmer among all POKéMON. It swims effortlessly, even in a rough, stormy sea. It sometimes rescues people from wrecked ships floundering in high seas.
Description (en, emerald): A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.
Description (en, firered): The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.
Description (en, leafgreen): Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
Description (en, pearl): The flippers of its well-developed limbs give it shocking speed. It is the best swimmer among Pokémon.
Description (en, platinum): It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
Description (en, heartgold): When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
Description (en, soulsilver): It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
Description (en, black-2): When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.
Description (ko, x): 해 질 무렵 강가에 모습을 나타낸다. 이마가 이상하게 빛날 때 신통력을 발휘한다고 전해진다.
Description (ko, y): 손바닥이 물갈퀴로 되어 있어 헤엄을 잘 친다. 호수 등에서 우아한 모습을 볼 수 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 손발의 물갈퀴와 유선형의 몸이 수중에서 무서울 만큼 빠른 스피드를 낸다. 금메달리스트보다 단연 빠르다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of Golduck give it frightening speed. This Pokémon is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 헤엄치는 스피드는 포켓몬 중 제일이다. 태풍으로 거칠어진 바다라도 문제없다. 난파선에서 사람을 구해내는 일도 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Golduck is the fastest swimmer among all Pokémon. It swims effortlessly, even in a rough, stormy sea. It sometimes rescues people from wrecked ships floundering in high seas.
Description (ko, sun): 이마의 붉은 부분을 가지면 신통력을 얻을 수 있다고 전해져 남획되었던 과거도 있다.
Description (en, sun): It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who possess one, so it was over-hunted in the past.
Description (ko, moon): 호수 근처를 헤엄쳐 다니며 잡은 물고기포켓몬을 물가에서 조용히 먹고 있다.
Description (en, moon): It swims along the banks of lakes and catches fish Pokémon. It takes them to the shore and quietly eats them up.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 빠르게 헤엄치는 물고기포켓몬이라도 사슬묶기로 꼼짝 못 하게 해서 쉽게 잡을 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수영의 전문가다. 긴 꼬리를 능숙하게 흔들어서 이틀 내내 헤엄칠 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 날씬하고 긴 팔다리와 발달한 큰 물갈퀴로 호수를 우아하게 헤엄친다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.
Description (ko, sword): 잔잔히 흐르는 강에 산다. 긴 팔다리로 물을 헤치며 우아하게 헤엄친다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.
Description (ko, shield): 강을 더럽힌 사람을 물속으로 끌어들여 데려간다는 옛날이야기가 전해져 오고 있다.
Description (en, shield): Old tales tell of Golduck punishing those that defiled its river. The guilty were dragged into the water and taken away.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

document.title: mankey — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: mankey

Name (ko): 망키
Name (en): Mankey
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: brown
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
Description (en, yellow): An agile POKéMON that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
Description (en, gold): It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
Description (en, silver): It's unsafe to ap­ proach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can't distinguish friends from foes.
Description (en, crystal): It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
Description (en, ruby): When MANKEY starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
Description (en, emerald): When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
Description (en, firered): Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
Description (en, leafgreen): Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.
Description (en, diamond): It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
Description (en, soulsilver): It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
Description (ko, x): 이유 없이 화내고 날뛰기 시작하면 동료도 구별하지 못하기 때문에 가까이 가는 것은 매우 위험하다.
Description (ko, y): 나무 위에서 생활하고 있다. 무리 중 1마리가 화내기 시작하면 모두 아무 의미도 없이 난동을 부린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸이 떨리며 콧김이 거칠어지면 화를 낼 조짐이지만 순식간에 격렬하게 화를 내기 때문에 도망갈 틈이 없다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): When Mankey starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
Description (ko, sun): 예고 없이 갑자기 화낸다. 마구 난동을 부려 모두가 곁을 떠나면 고독을 참지 못하고 또 화낸다.
Description (en, sun): It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.
Description (ko, moon): 마구 화를 내다 지쳐서 잠이 들지만 꿈속에서 화를 내서 분노로 일어나고 일어났다는 사실에 또 화를 낸다.
Description (en, moon): Its raging tires it out and causes it to fall asleep, but the anger resonating in its dreams causes it to wake up—which infuriates it all over again.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 작은 일에도 금방 화를 낸다. 스트레스를 쌓아 두지 않아서 꽤 오래 사는 포켓몬이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn’t hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 1마리가 화를 내면 주변에서도 화를 내기 때문에 망키 무리가 조용해지는 일은 없다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 몸이 가벼워 나무 위에서 생활한다. 사소한 일로 기분이 나빠져 주변에 있는 것에 덤벼든다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

document.title: primeape — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: primeape
ID: 57
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 성원숭
Name (en): Primeape
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: brown
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
Description (en, yellow): It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
Description (en, gold): If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
Description (en, silver): It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.
Description (en, crystal): It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.
Description (en, ruby): When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
Description (en, emerald): When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.
Description (en, firered): It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.
Description (en, leafgreen): Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.
Description (en, diamond): It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
Description (ko, x): 주위에 아무도 없을 때만은 화를 내지 않고 있다. 그러나 그 모습을 보기가 어렵다.
Description (ko, y): 항상 맹렬하게 화내고 있어 도망치고 또 도망쳐도 끝까지 쫓아온다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 격렬하게 화를 내면 혈액순환이 좋아져 근육의 힘을 강하게 만든다. 단 머리 회전은 느려진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): When Primeape becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
Description (ko, sun): 너무 화를 내서 그대로 사망하는 경우가 있을 정도지만 죽은 후의 얼굴은 매우 평온하다.
Description (en, sun): It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.
Description (ko, moon): 어느 연구자의 학설에 의하면 몬스터볼 안에서도 성원숭은 화나 있다는 듯하다.
Description (en, moon): Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 화나게 한 상대를 용서하지 않고 계속 쫓아다닌다. 때려눕혀 움직일 수 없게 돼도 용서하지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can’t move, it never ever forgives.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 다른 포켓몬들보다도 뇌의 혈관이 튼튼해서 계속 화를 내도 건강을 유지한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

document.title: growlithe — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: growlithe
ID: 58
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 가디
Name (en): Growlithe
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: brown
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
Description (en, yellow): A POKéMON with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
Description (en, gold): It has a brave and trustworthy na­ ture. It fear­ lessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
Description (en, silver): Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any oppo­ nent to protect its own trainer from harm.
Description (en, crystal): It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.
Description (en, ruby): GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this POKéMON won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
Description (en, emerald): Its superb sense of smell ensures that this POKéMON won’t forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.
Description (en, firered): Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
Description (en, leafgreen): It is very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
Description (en, heartgold): It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
Description (en, soulsilver): Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
Description (en, black-2): Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.
Description (ko, x): 사람을 잘 따르는 충실한 성격이다. 적에게는 짖거나 물며 쫓아내려고 한다.
Description (ko, y): 자신보다 강하고 큰 상대라도 겁 없이 맞서는 용감하고 믿음직한 성격이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 후각이 뛰어나서 한 번 맡은 냄새는 무슨 일이 있어도 절대 잊지 않는다. 상대의 기분을 냄새로 감지한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokémon won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
Description (ko, sun): 똑똑하고 충실하다. 다만 모르는 자나 영역을 침범하는 자에게는 짖어대서 위협한다.
Description (en, sun): It’s both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.
Description (ko, moon): 귀엽다고 해서 모르는 트레이너의 가디에게 다가가면 짖거나 물리기도 한다.
Description (en, moon): It looks cute, but when you approach another Trainer’s Growlithe, it will bark at you and bite.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 익숙해지면 사람을 잘 따르지만, 야생에서는 암멍이와 영역을 두고 격렬히 다툰다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): While it’s quite friendly toward humans once it’s grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먼 옛날부터 인간과 함께 생활해 왔다. 석기 시대 유적에서 뼈가 출토되었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It has lived alongside humans since ages ago. Its bones have been found in excavations of ruins from the Stone Age.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 사람을 잘 따르는 성격이지만 영역에 들어온 상대에게는 격렬하게 짖는다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
Description (ko, sword): 자신보다 강하고 큰 상대라도 겁 없이 맞서는 용감하고 믿음직스런 성격이다.
Description (ko, shield): 충직한 성격으로 자신의 트레이너를 지키기 위해 필사적으로 상대방에게 짖어댄다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

Description (en, red): A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
Description (en, yellow): A legendary POKé­ MON in China. Many people are charmed by its grace and beauty while running.
Description (en, gold): This legendary Chinese POKEMON is considered magnif­ icent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
Description (en, silver): Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.
Description (en, crystal): An ancient picture scroll shows that people were attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.
Description (en, ruby): ARCANINE is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this POKéMON’s body is its source of power.
Description (en, emerald): This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.
Description (en, firered): A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.
Description (en, leafgreen): A POKéMON that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
Description (en, diamond): Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
Description (en, heartgold): This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.
Description (en, black-2): The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
Description (ko, x): 옛날부터 많은 사람의 마음을 사로잡은 아름다운 포켓몬이다. 날듯이 경쾌하게 달린다.
Description (en, x): A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
Description (ko, y): 위풍당당한 울음소리는 위엄이 넘쳐 소리를 들은 상대는 무의식중에 몸을 움츠리게 된다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 10000km 거리를 하루 만에 달려간다고 전해지는 매우 빠른 포켓몬이다. 체내에서 불타오르는 불꽃이 파워가 된다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Arcanine is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this Pokémon’s body is its source of power.
Description (ko, sun): 동양의 오래된 전설에도 등장한다. 위엄이 넘치며 늠름하면서 아름다운 포켓몬.
Description (en, sun): Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.
Description (ko, moon): 체내에서 불타오르는 불꽃을 에너지로 대지를 달린다. 많은 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, moon): The fire burning inside its body serves as the energy to fuel it as it runs great distances. It appears in many legends.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 아주 먼 옛날 어느 장수와 함께 싸워 나라를 다스렸다고 하는 전설이 남아 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 많은 전설이 남아 있어 전설의 포켓몬이라고 불리지만 의외로 발견되는 수는 많다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): There are so many old tales about them that they’re called legendary Pokémon, but there are way more of them around than you’d expect.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 동양의 전설의 포켓몬. 경쾌하게 달리는 그 모습에 반하는 자도 많다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A legendary Pokémon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.
Description (ko, sword): 하루 만에 10000km의 거리를 달리는 모습은 많은 사람을 매료시켜 왔다.
Description (ko, shield): 옛날부터 많은 사람의 마음을 사로잡은 아름다운 포켓몬이다. 마치 나는 것처럼 경쾌하게 달린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: poliwag
ID: 60
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 발챙이
Name (en): Poliwag
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: blue
shape: legs
Description (en, red): Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
Description (en, yellow): The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
Description (en, gold): Because it is in­ ept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
Description (en, silver): The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.
Description (en, crystal): The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.
Description (en, ruby): POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the POKéMON’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
Description (en, emerald): It is possible to see this POKéMON’s spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
Description (en, firered): Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.
Description (en, diamond): Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
Description (en, heartgold): Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
Description (ko, x): 매끄럽고 검은 피부는 얇고 축축하다. 내장 일부가 비쳐서 소용돌이 모양으로 보인다.
Description (ko, y): 배의 소용돌이 방향은 태어난 지방에 따라 다른 듯하다. 걷기보다 헤엄치기를 잘한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 소용돌이 모양인 내장이 비칠 정도로 얇은 피부이지만 날카로운 이빨을 튕겨내는 탄력을 지니고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokémon’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
Description (ko, sun): 소용돌이는 비쳐서 보이는 내장이다. 그 색이 희뿌열 때는 뭔가 병에 걸린 것이다.
Description (en, sun): The swirl on its belly is its internal organs showing through. If the swirl is tinged white, that means it’s affected by some disease.
Description (ko, moon): 아직 걷는 것이 서투르다. 트레이너가 되면 매일 걷는 훈련을 시켜주자.
Description (en, moon): It’s still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 위험한데도 지상으로 올라가고 싶어한다. 아직 아장아장 걷기 때문에 적에게 노출되면 황급히 물속으로 들어간다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 소용돌이의 방향은 지역에 따라 미묘하게 다르다. 발챙이 마니아는 한눈에 구분할 수 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The direction of the swirl on their stomachs differs depending on where they live. Poliwag aficionados can tell them apart at a glance.
Description (ko, sword): 걷기보다 헤엄치기가 특기다. 배의 소용돌이 모양은 내장의 일부가 비쳐 보이는 것이다.
Description (en, sword): For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.
Description (ko, shield): 유속이 빠른 강에서는 두꺼운 입술을 흡반처럼 사용해 바위에 달라붙는다.
Description (en, shield): In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

document.title: poliwhirl — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: poliwhirl
ID: 61
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 슈륙챙이
Name (en): Poliwhirl
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: blue
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
Description (en, yellow): Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.
Description (en, gold): The swirl on its belly subtly un­ dulates. Staring at it may gradual­ ly cause drowsi­ ness.
Description (en, silver): The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.
Description (en, crystal): Though it is skilled at walk­ ing, it prefers to live underwater where there is less danger.
Description (en, ruby): The surface of POLIWHIRL’s body is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
Description (en, emerald): Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
Description (en, firered): Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.
Description (en, leafgreen): It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
Description (en, diamond): The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
Description (en, heartgold): The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.
Description (ko, x): 육지에서도 수중에서도 살 수 있다. 지상에서는 항상 땀을 흘려서 피부를 미끌미끌하게 하고 있다.
Description (ko, y): 두 다리가 발달하여 지상에서 살 수 있는데도 어째서인지 수중 생활을 좋아한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 항상 몸의 표면이 액체로 미끈미끈하게 젖어 있어서 적에게 붙잡혀도 미끄덩 빠져나와 도망갈 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The surface of Poliwhirl’s body is always wet and slick with a slimy fluid. Because of this slippery covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
Description (ko, sun): 육지 위에서도 문제없이 살 수 있지만 천적인 포켓몬이 적어서 물속 생활을 선호한다.
Description (en, sun): Although it can live on land, it prefers to stay in the water, where it has fewer natural enemies.
Description (ko, moon): 육지를 누비며 먹이인 벌레포켓몬을 찾는다. 먹는 곳은 안전한 물 속이다.
Description (en, moon): It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it’s safe.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 지상에서 살 수 있게 되었는데도 먹이인 물고기포켓몬이 많은 수중에서 지낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 피부가 건조해지면 기력이 없어지게 되므로 부지런히 수분을 보충해 주자.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its health suffers when its skin dries out, so be sure to moisturize it diligently.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 공격당할 위기에 처하면 배에 있는 소용돌이를 사용해 상대를 잠들게 한 뒤 그 틈에 도망치는 듯하다.
Description (ko, sword): 배의 소용돌이를 계속 보다 보면 잠이 온다. 자장가 대용으로 아이를 재울 때도 사용한다.
Description (en, sword): Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.
Description (ko, shield): 미끈미끈한 점액 형태의 땀을 흘린다. 적에게 붙잡혀도 스르륵 빠져나와 도망친다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

document.title: poliwrath — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: poliwrath
ID: 62
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 강챙이
Name (en): Poliwrath
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: blue
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
Description (en, yellow): Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake champion swimmers.
Description (en, gold): This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
Description (en, silver): Although an ener­ getic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its mus­ cles, it lives on dry land.
Description (en, crystal): It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
Description (en, ruby): POLIWRATH’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
Description (en, emerald): Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
Description (en, firered): An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.
Description (en, leafgreen): A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
Description (en, diamond): With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
Description (en, soulsilver): Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.
Description (ko, x): 강인한 근육을 가지고 있다. 태평양을 쉬지 않고 계속 헤엄칠 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 자유형이나 접영을 잘하여 올림픽 선수도 제치고 쑥쑥 앞질러 나아간다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강인하게 발달한 근육은 아무리 운동해도 지치는 일이 없다. 태평양도 가볍게 횡단할 수 있을 정도다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Poliwrath’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this Pokémon can swim back and forth across the ocean without effort.
Description (ko, sun): 알로라의 강챙이는 평영을 잘한다. 강챙이 흉내로 헤엄을 배우는 아이들도 많다.
Description (en, sun): Poliwrath in the Alola region are strong swimmers that use the breaststroke. Many children learn to swim by imitating Poliwrath.
Description (ko, moon): 체지방률은 거의 0% 전신이 근육인 관계로 무거워서 헤엄치는 힘이 발달했다.
Description (en, moon): Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 물포켓몬 중에서도 수영 실력이 매우 뛰어난 부류인데도 평상시에는 지상에서 지낸다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 수영으로 단련한 근육은 두텁고 강하다. 정권 지르기로 큰 바위도 가루로 만들어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The muscles it has developed through swimming are thick and powerful. When it lands a square punch, it can turn huge boulders to dust.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 전신의 근육을 사용한 파워풀한 헤엄으로 세계 레벨급 선수도 앞질러 간다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.
Description (ko, sword): 전신이 근육 덩어리다. 추운 바다에서도 늠름한 팔로 유빙을 부수며 힘차게 나아간다.
Description (en, sword): Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.
Description (ko, shield): 헤엄뿐만 아니라 격투기도 특기다. 단련한 팔로 호쾌하게 펀치를 날린다.
Description (en, shield): Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

document.body:

Name (ko): 캐이시
Name (en): Abra
generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: brown
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
Description (en, yellow): Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
Description (en, gold): It senses impend­ ing attacks and TELEPORTS away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
Description (en, silver): If it decides to TELEPORT randomly, it creates the illusion that it has created copies of itself.
Description (en, crystal): It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.
Description (en, ruby): ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this POKéMON immediately teleports to safety.
Description (en, sapphire): ABRA needs to sleep for eighteen hours a day. If it doesn’t, this POKéMON loses its ability to use telekinetic powers. If it is attacked, ABRA escapes using TELEPORT while it is still sleeping.
Description (en, emerald): A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.
Description (en, firered): It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
Description (en, leafgreen): Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
Description (en, diamond): It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
Description (en, pearl): Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar. It teleports when it is threatened.
Description (en, platinum): Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
Description (en, heartgold): It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
Description (en, soulsilver): If it decides to teleport randomly, it evokes the illusion that it has created copies of itself.
Description (ko, x): 하루에 18시간은 자고 있다. 자는 동안에도 다양한 초능력을 사용한다.
Description (ko, y): 공격의 낌새를 읽고 공격당하기 전에 얼른 순간이동으로 그 장소를 떠난다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 하루에 18시간 잠들어 있는 포켓몬이다. 잠든 상태에서도 적의 기척을 감지하면 순간이동하여 도망갈 수 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Abra sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokémon immediately teleports to safety.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 매일 18시간을 자지 않으면 수면 부족으로 초능력을 사용할 수 없게 된다. 습격당하면 잠든 채로 순간이동하여 도망간다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Abra needs to sleep for eighteen hours a day. If it doesn’t, this Pokémon loses its ability to use telekinetic powers. If it is attacked, Abra escapes using Teleport while it is still sleeping.
Description (ko, sun): 1일 18시간을 잔다. 잠든 채 순간이동으로 나무 위에 이동하여 나무열매를 따서 먹는다.
Description (en, sun): It sleeps 18 hours a day. Even while sleeping, it will teleport itself to treetops and pick and eat berries there.
Description (ko, moon): 잠든 사이에도 순간이동 해서 몸을 지키지만 깨어났을 때 어디에 있는지 몰라서 당황한다.
Description (en, moon): It can teleport itself to safety while it’s asleep, but when it wakes, it doesn’t know where it is, so it panics.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 자는 동안에도 다양한 초능력을 사용하기 때문에 깨어 있는 것이 아닌지 헷갈린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It uses various psychic powers even while it’s sleeping, so you can’t tell whether or not it’s awake.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 상대의 마음을 읽어서 위험이 닥치기 전에 순간이동한다. 잡으려면 마음을 비워야 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It can read others’ minds and will teleport away when danger approaches. You must clear your mind if you want to catch it.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 하루에 18시간을 잔다. 위험이 닥치면 잠든 상태에서도 순간이동해서 도망친다.
Description (ko, sword): 자면서 초능력을 구사한다. 꿈의 내용이 사용하는 힘에 영향을 준다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.
Description (ko, shield): 잠이 든 상태에서 순간이동이 가능하다. 깊이 잠들수록 먼 곳으로 이동한다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

document.body:

Name (ko): 윤겔라
Name (en): Kadabra
generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: brown
shape: upright
Description (en, red): It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
Description (en, yellow): Many odd things happen if this POKéMON is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backwards.
Description (en, gold): It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
Description (en, silver): If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.
Description (en, crystal): When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti­ cles come out of the surface of its body.
Description (en, ruby): KADABRA emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a TRAINER of this POKéMON.
Description (en, sapphire): KADABRA holds a silver spoon in its hand. The spoon is used to amplify the alpha waves in its brain. Without the spoon, the POKéMON is said to be limited to half the usual amount of its telekinetic powers.
Description (en, emerald): It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
Description (en, firered): It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.
Description (en, leafgreen): It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.
Description (en, diamond): If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
Description (en, pearl): When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong ha waves that can ruin precision devices.
Description (en, platinum): It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
Description (ko, x): 초능력을 발휘하면 강한 알파파를 내어 정밀 기계를 고장 내 버린다.
Description (en, x): When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.
Description (ko, y): 능력을 사용할 때마다 몸에서 특수한 알파파를 발산하여 기계를 교란시킨다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 두통을 유발하는 특수한 알파파를 발산하기 때문에 강한 정신력의 소유자가 아니면 윤겔라의 트레이너가 될 수 없다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Kadabra emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a Trainer of this Pokémon.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 은 숟가락은 알파파를 높여준다. 숟가락이 없으면 평상시의 반밖에 초능력을 사용할 수 없게 된다고 한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Kadabra holds a silver spoon in its hand. The spoon is used to amplify the alpha waves in its brain. Without the spoon, the Pokémon is said to be limited to half the usual amount of its telekinetic powers.
Description (ko, sun): 에스퍼 소년이 자신 안의 사이코 파워를 억누르지 못하고 변신했다는 설도 있다.
Description (en, sun): A theory exists that this Pokémon was a young boy who couldn’t control his psychic powers and ended up transformed into this Pokémon.
Description (ko, moon): 윤겔라가 있을 때 TV 등 기계 모니터에 불행을 부르는 으스스한 그림자가 스쳐 간다.
Description (en, moon): Kadabra’s presence infests televisions and monitors with creepy shadows that bring bad luck.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 은 숟가락을 가만히 주시하고 사이코 파워를 증폭하여 발산한다. 금 숟가락으로는 안 되는 듯하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It stares at a silver spoon to amplify its psychic powers before it lets loose. Apparently, gold spoons are no good.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 강한 정신력을 가졌지만 은 숟가락이 없으면 사이코 파워가 반감되어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It possesses strong mental capabilities, but its psychic powers are halved when it’s not holding a silver spoon.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 윤겔라가 근처에 있으면 시계가 거꾸로 도는 등 이상한 일들이 일어나는 듯하다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.
Description (ko, sword): 사이코 파워로 공중에 떠서 잠든다. 탄력이 뛰어난 꼬리를 베개 대신으로 사용한다.
Description (en, sword): Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
Description (ko, shield): 염동력의 위력은 절대적이다. 진화에 대비하여 이마에 있는 별에 사이코 파워를 비축하고 있다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon’s telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.
Description (en, legends-arceus): There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

Name (ko): 우츠동
Name (en): Weepinbell
generation: generation-i
habitat: forest
color: green
shape: blob
Description (en, red): It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
Description (en, yellow): When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is melted inside by strong acids.
Description (en, gold): Even though it is filled with ACID, it does not melt because it also oozes a neutral­ izing fluid.
Description (en, silver): If its prey is bigger than its mouth, it slices up the victim with sharp leaves, then eats every morsel.
Description (en, crystal): When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.
Description (en, ruby): WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
Description (en, emerald): At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
Description (en, firered): The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
Description (en, heartgold): Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.
Description (ko, x): 잎사귀 부분은 칼날이 되어 상대를 베어버린다. 입에서는 무엇이든 녹이는 액체를 뿜어낸다.
Description (ko, y): 우선 독가루를 뿌려 상대의 움직임을 멈추게 하고 나서 용해액으로 숨통을 끊는다.
Description (en, y): It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 밤이 되면 엉덩이의 갈고리를 나뭇가지에 걸고 매달려서 잠든다. 잠버릇이 나쁘면 아침에 떨어져 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Weepinbell has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokémon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 배가 고프면 움직이는 것을 닥치는 대로 삼킨 다음 용해액으로 마무리한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

document.body:

ID: 71
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 우츠보트
Name (en): Victreebel
generation: generation-i
habitat: forest
color: green
shape: blob
Description (en, red): Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
Description (en, yellow): Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is melted in a day, bones and all.
Description (en, gold): ACID that has dis­ solved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
Description (en, silver): This horrifying plant POKéMON at­ tracts prey with aromatic honey, then melts them in its mouth.
Description (en, crystal): Once ingested into this POKéMON's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.
Description (en, ruby): VICTREEBEL has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this POKéMON swallows it whole.
Description (en, emerald): The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.
Description (en, firered): Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.
Description (en, diamond): It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
Description (en, heartgold): Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
Description (en, soulsilver): This horrifying plant Pokémon attracts prey with aromatic honey, then melts them in its mouth.
Description (en, black-2): It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honey-like scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
Description (ko, x): 정글의 안쪽에 우츠보트만 있는 지대가 있어서 한 번 가면 두 번 다시 돌아올 수 없다.
Description (ko, y): 체내로 거둬들인 것은 아무리 단단할지라도 용해액으로 흔적도 없이 녹여버린다.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Victreebel has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokémon swallows it whole.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 꿀 냄새로 먹이를 끌어들인다. 입안에 넣은 것은 하루 만에 뼈까지 녹여버린다고 한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

document.title: tentacool — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: tentacool
ID: 72
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 왕눈해
Name (en): Tentacool
generation: generation-i
habitat: sea
color: blue
shape: tentacles
Description (en, red): Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
Description (en, yellow): It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
Description (en, gold): When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
Description (en, silver): It drifts aimless­ ly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
Description (en, crystal): As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.
Description (en, ruby): TENTACOOL’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this POKéMON happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
Description (en, sapphire): TENTACOOL absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. This POKéMON shoots beams from its crystal-like eyes.
Description (en, emerald): Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
Description (en, firered): Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.
Description (en, leafgreen): Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.
Description (en, diamond): Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
Description (en, pearl): It drifts in sea currents. Countless fishermen are hurt by its poison stingers.
Description (en, platinum): Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
Description (en, soulsilver): It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
Description (ko, x): 몸 대부분이 수분이다. 수정 같은 눈에서 이상한 빔을 발사한다.
Description (ko, y): 바다 얕은 곳을 떠다닌다. 낚시꾼이 실수로 낚아 올려 찔리는 일이 많다고 한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸 대부분이 물로 되어 있어 바다에서 나오면 바싹 말라버린다. 말라버렸을 때는 바다로 돌려보내 주자.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Tentacool’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this Pokémon happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 태양 광선을 몸 안의 수분으로 굴절시켜서 빔 에너지로 바꾼다. 수정 같은 눈알에서 발사된다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Tentacool absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. This Pokémon shoots beams from the small round organ above its eyes.
Description (ko, sun): 해변 등에서 말라버렸지만 아직 살아 있는 경우도 많다. 물에 적시면 불면서 부활한다.
Description (en, sun): They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.
Description (ko, moon): 모래 해변 등의 얕은 물가를 떠돈다. 독 촉수에 쏘이거나 물리면 서둘러 병원에 가자.
Description (en, moon): It drifts in shallow seas, such as the areas near beaches. If you get bitten or stabbed by its toxic tentacles, rush to the hospital.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 해변을 떠다니며 먹이를 찾는다. 독이 있는 촉수는 끊어지기도 하지만 시간이 흐르면 다시 자란다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 몸의 99퍼센트가 수분이다. 남은 1퍼센트에 독소를 만드는 기관이 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 물가에 바싹 마른 상태로 발견될 때도 있지만 물에 담가주면 부활한다.
Description (ko, sword): 헤엄치는 힘은 강하지 않다. 얕은 바다 수면을 떠다니면서 먹이를 찾는다.
Description (en, sword): Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.
Description (ko, shield): 몸의 대부분이 수분이어서 바닷속에서는 물과 동화되어 매우 구분하기 힘들다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.
Description (en, legends-arceus): They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

document.title: tentacruel — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:

Name: tentacruel
ID: 73
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 독파리
Name (en): Tentacruel
generation: generation-i
habitat: sea
color: blue
shape: tentacles
Description (en, red): The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
Description (en, yellow): Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
Description (en, gold): Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to CON­ STRICT its prey and enemies.
Description (en, silver): In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its oppo­ nent inside a poisonous net.
Description (en, crystal): When its 80 feel­ ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.
Description (en, ruby): TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This POKéMON’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
Description (en, sapphire): TENTACRUEL has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.
Description (en, emerald): It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
Description (en, firered): It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
Description (en, diamond): With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
Description (en, pearl): It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.
Description (en, platinum): It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
Description (en, heartgold): Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.
Description (en, soulsilver): In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.
Description (ko, x): 촉수는 평소에는 짧고 먹이를 찌를 때 길게 늘어나 휘감는다.
Description (ko, y): 80개의 촉수를 자유롭게 움직인다. 찔리면 독이 퍼져 극심한 고통을 겪게 된다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 머리의 붉은 구슬이 반짝일 때 격렬한 초음파가 주변에 발사된다. 그때 바다가 격렬히 파도친다고 한다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Tentacruel has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokémon’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 자유롭게 늘었다 줄었다 하는 촉수로 먹이를 휘감아 맹독을 주입해 약하게 만든다. 한 번에 80마리의 먹이를 잡는다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Tentacruel has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.
Description (ko, sun): 독 촉수는 보통 80개다. 오래 산 포켓몬일수록 그 개수는 줄어든다.
Description (en, sun): Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.
Description (ko, moon): 드물게 대량 발생하면 주변 바다에서 물고기포켓몬이 모두 사라져 버리고 만다.
Description (en, moon): Although these Pokémon are rare, when a large outbreak of them occurs, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 붉은 구슬로 초음파를 발생시켜 먹이가 약해지면 80개의 촉수로 휘감는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 붉은 구슬을 빛내서 동료와 교신하고 있다. 깜빡이는 것은 경계를 알리는 신호다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it’s a warning sign.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 80개의 촉수를 자유자재로 늘이고 줄여 먹이를 휘감은 뒤 독을 주입해서 약하게 만든다.
Description (ko, sword): 머리의 빨간 구슬이 밝게 빛나면 주의가 필요하다. 초음파를 발산하려는 전조다.
Description (en, sword): When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.
Description (ko, shield): 80개의 촉수는 자유롭게 늘어났다가 줄어든다. 그물처럼 펼쳐서 먹이를 잡고 독바늘로 찌른다.
Description (en, shield): Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.
Description (en, legends-arceus): It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

document.body:

Name: geodude
ID: 74
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 꼬마돌
Name (en): Geodude
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: brown
shape: arms
Description (en, red): Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
Description (en, yellow): Commonly found near mountain trails, etc. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
Description (en, gold): Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
Description (en, silver): It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.
Description (en, crystal): Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.
Description (en, ruby): The longer a GEODUDE lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this POKéMON’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
Description (en, sapphire): When GEODUDE sleeps deeply, it buries itself halfway into the ground. It will not awaken even if hikers step on it unwittingly. In the morning, this POKéMON rolls downhill in search of food.
Description (en, emerald): It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
Description (en, firered): Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.
Description (en, diamond): Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
Description (en, pearl): It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams against others in contests of hardness.
Description (en, platinum): At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
Description (ko, x): 초원이나 산에 서식한다. 돌멩이와 닮은 탓에 알아채지 못하고 밟거나 발이 걸려 넘어지기도 한다.
Description (ko, y): 돌멩이와 구별되지 않는다. 튼튼한 몸을 동료와 서로 부딪쳐서 단단함을 겨룬다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 오래 산 꼬마돌일수록 몸의 모난 부분이 깎여 둥그렇게 되지만 마음은 언제까지나 울퉁불퉁 뾰족하고 거칠다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): The longer a Geodude lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokémon’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 땅에 반쯤 박혀서 푹 잠잔다. 등산 중인 사람에게 밟혀도 전혀 깨지 않는다. 아침에 먹이를 찾아 언덕을 굴러 내려온다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): When Geodude sleeps deeply, it buries itself halfway into the ground. It will not awaken even if hikers step on it unwittingly. In the morning, this Pokémon rolls downhill in search of food.
Description (ko, sun): 동글고 들기 쉽지만 서로 던지기에는 딱딱하고 무겁다. 눈싸움처럼 서로 맞히며 놀기에는 위험하다.
Description (en, sun): Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It’s dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.
Description (ko, moon): 길가에서 흔히 볼 수 있다. 한가한 학자가 세어봤더니 하나의 도로에 100마리가 있었다.
Description (en, moon): There are plenty of them to be found along any road. A scholar with too much free time once counted a hundred of them along a single route.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 오래 산 꼬마돌은 모가 없이 동그랗다. 성격도 매우 차분하고 온화하다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they’re totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 양손을 사용해서 험한 절벽을 오른다. 그 모습을 본 사람이 볼더링을 시작했다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 산길 등에 많이 서식한다. 실수로 밟으면 화를 내므로 주의가 필요하다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.

Name (en): Graveler
generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: brown
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
Description (en, yellow): Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
Description (en, gold): With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
Description (en, silver): A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.
Description (en, crystal): It travels by rol­ ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.
Description (en, ruby): GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This POKéMON eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
Description (en, sapphire): Rocks are GRAVELER’s favorite food. This POKéMON will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.
Description (en, emerald): They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
Description (en, firered): Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.
Description (en, diamond): GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
Description (en, pearl): It tumbles down slopes, heedless of any body parts chipping off. It eats a ton of rocks daily.
Description (en, platinum): It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
Description (en, heartgold): With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
Description (ko, x): 산에서 굴러 떨어질 때 몸의 여기저기가 부서져도 신경 쓰지 않는 호쾌한 성격이다.
Description (ko, y): 언덕을 굴러서 이동한다. 방해물은 마구 짓누르며 나아간다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 바위를 먹고 성장하는 포켓몬이다. 이끼가 낀 바위를 좋아하는 것 같다. 하루에 1톤의 바위를 먹어버린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Graveler grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokémon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 산기슭부터 산 정상까지 올라가는 동안 매우 좋아하는 바위를 으득으득 먹는다. 정상에 도달하면 다시 굴러 내려온다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Rocks are Graveler’s favorite food. This Pokémon will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.
Description (ko, sun): 이끼가 낀 바위를 아주 좋아한다. 어적어적 소리를 내면서 1일 1톤 이상을 먹는다.
Description (en, sun): Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.
Description (ko, moon): 발이 둔해서 몸을 둥글게 말아 굴러서 이동한다. 기세가 더해지면 시속 100km를 넘는다.
Description (en, moon): This slow-footed Pokémon moves by curling up and rolling instead of walking. With enough momentum, its speed can exceed 60 mph.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 정상을 목표로 절벽을 오른다. 정상에 도착하면 곧바로 올라온 산길을 굴러 내려간다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 절벽을 굴러서 이동한다. 실수로 강에 떨어지면 최후의 발악으로 대폭발한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 산길에서 자주 굴러다닌다. 가는 길에 무엇이 있든 전혀 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

generation: generation-i
habitat: mountain
color: brown
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
Description (en, yellow): Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
Description (en, gold): It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hard­ ens and crumbles away.
Description (en, silver): It is capable of blowing itself up. It uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.
Description (en, crystal): Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.
Description (en, ruby): GOLEM live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these POKéMON will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
Description (en, sapphire): GOLEM is known for rolling down from mountains. To prevent them from rolling into the homes of people downhill, grooves have been dug into the sides of mountains to serve as guideways for diverting this POKéMON’s course.
Description (en, emerald): It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
Description (en, firered): It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.
Description (en, diamond): It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
Description (en, pearl): It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
Description (en, platinum): Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
Description (en, heartgold): It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.
Description (en, black-2): Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
Description (ko, x): 산 정상에서 산기슭까지 이어지는 움푹 패인 홈은 딱구리가 굴러 다니는 길이므로 주의가 필요하다.
Description (ko, y): 암석 같은 단단한 몸은 다이너마이트로도 상처를 입힐 수 없다. 1년에 1번 탈피한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 큰 지진이 일어나면 산에 사는 딱구리 여러 마리가 산기슭까지 데굴데굴 굴러 내려오는 일이 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Golem live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokémon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 산의 경사면에 파놓은 홈은 굴러 내려오는 딱구리가 민가에 부딪히지 않게 하기 위한 코스로 되어 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Golem is known for rolling down from mountains. To prevent them from rolling into the homes of people downhill, grooves have been dug into the sides of mountains to serve as guideways for diverting this Pokémon’s course.
Description (ko, sun): 다이너마이트로 폭파해도 상처 하나 입지 않는 몸이지만 습기나 비는 아주 싫어한다.
Description (en, sun): Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.
Description (ko, moon): 1년에 1번 탈피한다. 벗어낸 껍데기는 흙으로 돌아가 토양을 비옥하게 해서 농가에서 모으고 있다.
Description (en, moon): Once a year, this Pokémon molts, and its shed shell returns to the soil. This process creates enriched soil, so farmers collect the shells.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 나이가 들면 탈피를 하지 않는다. 긴 세월을 산 딱구리의 껍질은 이끼가 끼어 초록색이다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 스스로 몸을 폭발시킨다. 그 파워로 가파른 산길도 굉장한 스피드로 올라간다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 탈피한 직후에는 전체가 하얗고 부드럽지만 금방 공기와 접촉해서 단단해진다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.
Description (en, legends-arceus): The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: yellow
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
Description (en, yellow): Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
Description (en, gold): It is a weak run­ ner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
Description (en, silver): Its hind legs, which have hard­ er-than-diamond hooves, kick back at any presence it senses behind it.
Description (en, crystal): Training by jumping over grass that grows longer every day has made it a world-class jumper.
Description (en, ruby): PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This POKéMON becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
Description (en, emerald): A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.
Description (en, firered): Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.
Description (en, leafgreen): Its hooves are ten times harder than diamond. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
Description (en, diamond): About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.
Description (en, pearl): Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.
Description (en, platinum): As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
Description (en, heartgold): It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its hind legs, which have hooves that are harder than diamond, kick back at any presence it senses behind it.
Description (ko, x): 막 태어나서는 겨우 일어설 수 있을 정도이지만 많이 달리면 하반신이 단련되어 달리는 속도가 빨라진다.
Description (ko, y): 부모의 뒤를 쫓아다니는 동안 다리가 강인해진다. 온종일 산과 들을 뛰어다닌다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 막 태어나서는 겨우 설 수 있는 정도지만 넘어지면서 부모의 뒤를 쫓아다니는 동안 하반신이 튼튼하게 자라난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 엄청난 점프 뒤에 오는 착지의 충격은 발굽과 다리의 근육으로 완화한다.
Description (ko, sword): 갓 태어났을 때는 달리는 것이 서툴다. 동료와 달리기 경주를 하는 사이에 하반신이 튼튼하게 성장한다.
Description (en, sword): It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
Description (ko, shield): 포니타에게 인정받으면 타오르는 갈기를 만져도 뜨거움을 느끼지 않게 된다.
Description (en, shield): If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.
Description (en, legends-arceus): These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

habitat: grassland
color: yellow
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
Description (en, yellow): Just loves to run. If it sees some­ thing faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
Description (en, gold): At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredi­ bly fast.
Description (en, silver): With incredible acceleration, it reaches its top speed of 150 mph after running just ten steps.
Description (en, crystal): It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the long­ er the swaying flames of its mane will become.
Description (en, ruby): RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this POKéMON turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
Description (en, emerald): It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
Description (en, firered): It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

Description (en, heartgold): At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

Description (en, omega-ruby): Rapidash usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this Pokémon turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 그저 달리는 것을 좋아해서 자신보다 빠른 상대를 발견하면 전속력으로 쫓아간다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
Description (ko, sword): 불타는 갈기를 휘날리며 시속 240km의 속도로 넓은 초원을 달려나간다.
Description (en, sword): This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
Description (ko, shield): 가장 발이 빠른 날쌩마가 리더가 되어 무리가 갈 장소나 달리는 속도를 정한다.
Description (en, shield): The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

document.body:

ID: 79

Name (ko): 야돈
Name (en): Slowpoke
generation: generation-i
habitat: waters-edge
color: pink
shape: quadruped
Description (en, red): Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
Description (en, yellow): Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
Description (en, gold): It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
Description (en, silver): A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.
Description (en, crystal): It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
Description (en, ruby): SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this POKéMON often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
Description (en, emerald): It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
Description (en, firered): It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
Description (en, leafgreen): Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
Description (en, diamond): Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
Description (en, heartgold): It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.
Description (en, soulsilver): A sweet sap leaks from its tail’s tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.
Description (ko, x): 항상 멍하니 있으므로 무슨 생각을 하고 있는지 알 수 없다. 꼬리로 먹이를 낚는 것이 특기다.
Description (ko, y): 물가에서 멍하니 있다. 뭔가가 꼬리를 깨물어도 하루 종일 눈치채지 못한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 꼬리를 강에 넣고 먹이를 낚지만 이윽고 무엇을 하고 있었는지 잊고 강변에 엎드려 누운 채로 하루를 보낸다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
Description (ko, sun): 긴 꼬리는 잘 잘린다. 특별히 아픔도 느끼지 않고 바로 자라기 때문에 신경 쓰지 않는다.
Description (en, sun): Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn’t really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn’t particularly bothered.
Description (ko, moon): 야돈의 꼬리를 말린 뒤 소금물에 푹 끓인 요리는 알로라의 가정식 메뉴다.
Description (en, moon): Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 하품을 하면 비가 온다는 구전 때문에 야돈을 받을어 모시는 지역도 있다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 주변에 자연스럽게 떨어져 있는 꼬리는 손쉽게 얻을 수 있는 귀중한 식재료 중 하나였다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Although their tails, which fall off naturally, can easily be found lying around, they’re a precious ingredient for cooking.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 매우 멍청하고 움직임도 둔하다. 시간의 흐름을 의식하지 않고 느긋하게 살고 있다.
Description (ko, sword): 멍청하고 둔감하다. 꼬리를 먹혀도 아픔을 느끼지 못하고 꼬리가 다시 자라도 눈치채지 못한다.
Description (en, sword): Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.
Description (ko, shield): 꼬리를 물에 담가두면 단맛이 배어 나오기 때문에 이를 미끼로 포켓몬을 유인해서 낚는다.
Description (en, shield): When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

document.body:

habitat: waters-edge
color: pink
shape: upright
Description (en, red): The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
Description (en, yellow): Lives lazily by the sea. If the SHELLDER on its tail comes off, it becomes a SLOWPOKE again.
Description (en, gold): If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordi­ nary SLOWPOKE.
Description (en, silver): Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to SHELLDER's seeping poison.
Description (en, crystal): An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
Description (en, ruby): SLOWBRO’s tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
Description (en, emerald): Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
Description (en, firered): When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.
Description (en, leafgreen): The SHELLDER that latches onto SLOWPOKE’s tail is said to feed on the host’s leftover scraps.
Description (en, diamond): Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
Description (en, heartgold): If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary SLOWPOKE.
Description (en, soulsilver): Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to SHELLDER’s seeping poison.
Description (en, black): Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
Description (ko, x): 붙어 있는 셀러는 꼬리에서 배어 나오는 맛을 좋아해서 계속 떨어지지 않는다.
Description (en, x): An attached Shellder won’t let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
Description (ko, y): 야돈이 바다로 먹이를 잡으러 갔다가 셀러에게 꼬리를 물려 야도란이 되었다.
Description (en, y): When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 셀러가 물고 있어서 꼬리로 먹이를 낚을 수 없게 된 야도란은 마지못해 물속을 헤엄쳐 먹이를 잡고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Slowbro’s tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
Description (ko, sun): 바다를 바라보며 멍하니 있다. 셀러의 독이 몸에 퍼져서 더욱 멍하니 있게 되었다.
Description (en, sun): It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder’s poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.
Description (ko, moon): 셀러가 세게 물 때마다 퍼뜩 무언가가 떠오르지만 순식간에 잊어버린다.
Description (en, moon): Whenever Shellder bites down hard on its tail, it gives Slowbro a flash of inspiration...which it forgets a moment later.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 기본적으로 멍하니 있다. 꼬리가 끊겨 셀러가 떨어지면 야돈으로 돌아간다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 꼬리의 단맛을 더 많이 마시기 위해 욕심을 낸 셀러가 고둥 모양으로 변화했다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Shellder, in its greed to suck out more and more sweetness from Slowbro’s tail, has metamorphosed into a spiral-shaped shell.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 바다 근처에서 느긋하게 산다. 만약 꼬리에 있는 셀러가 떨어지면 야돈으로 돌아간다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.
Description (ko, sword): 셀러에게 꼬리를 물려서 진화했다. 셀러는 꼬리에서 배어 나오는 단맛에 황홀한 기분이다.
Description (en, sword): Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.
Description (ko, shield): 셀러에게 물린 충격으로 두 발로 걸을 수 있게 되었다. 셀러가 떨어지면 야돈으로 돌아간다고 한다.
Description (en, shield): Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species

ID: 81
