Name (ko): 코일
Name (en): Magnemite
generation: generation-i
habitat: rough-terrain
color: gray
shape: arms
Description (en, red): Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
Description (en, yellow): It is born with the ability to defy gravity. It floats in air on powerful electro­ magnetic waves.
Description (en, gold): It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach trainers if they are using their POKéGEAR.
Description (en, silver): The units at the sides of its body generate anti­ gravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
Description (en, crystal): The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.
Description (en, ruby): MAGNEMITE attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this POKéMON clinging to the breaker box.
Description (en, sapphire): MAGNEMITE floats in the air by emitting electromagnetic waves from the units at its sides. These waves block gravity. This POKéMON becomes incapable of flight if its internal electrical supply is depleted.
Description (en, emerald): The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.
Description (en, firered): It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.
Description (en, leafgreen): Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
Description (en, diamond): The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.
Description (en, platinum): The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
Description (en, heartgold): It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach Trainers if they are using their Pokégear.
Description (en, soulsilver): The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
Description (en, black-2): The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
Description (ko, x): 좌우의 유닛에서 중력을 차단하는 힘을 발휘하기에 공중에 뜰 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 공중에 뜬 채로 이동하여 좌우의 유닛에서 전기자석파를 방사한다.
Description (en, y): It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 전선에 들러붙어 전기를 먹고 있다. 정전되면 누전차단기를 살펴보자. 코일이 빽빽이 들러붙어 있을지도 모른다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Magnemite attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this Pokémon clinging to the breaker box.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 좌우의 유닛에서 전자파를 내어 중력을 차단하여 공중에 뜬다. 체내의 전기가 없어지면 날지 못하게 된다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Magnemite floats in the air by emitting electromagnetic waves from the units at its sides. These waves block gravity. This Pokémon becomes incapable of flight if its internal electrical supply is depleted.
Description (ko, sun): 전기가 있는 장소에 무리를 짓는다. 전기를 보내는 철탑 등에 빈틈없이 붙어 있는 일도 있다.
Description (en, sun): They gather in places where electricity is available. They can be found clinging to the steel towers used to support power lines.
Description (ko, moon): 전기자석파를 발산하여 공중을 떠다닌다. 전기를 먹고 있을 때 만지면 전신이 찌릿하게 마비된다.
Description (en, moon): It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it’s eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 종종 정전의 원인이 되기 때문에 코일이 싫어하는 전파를 내보내는 발전소도 있을 정도다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can’t stand.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 최근에는 전선이 땅에 묻혀 있기 때문인지 발전소를 습격하는 코일이 늘고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Perhaps because electrical lines are often buried these days, the number of Magnemite attacks on power plants has increased.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 태어날 때부터 중력을 차단하는 능력을 가지고 있어 전자파를 내면서 공중을 이동한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity. It floats while emitting powerful electromagnetic waves.
Description (ko, sword): 체내의 전기가 끊겨 땅에서 뒹굴기도 한다. 전지를 주면 움직이기 시작한다.
Description (en, sword): At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it’ll start moving again.
Description (ko, shield): 전기를 먹으며 살아간다. 좌우의 유닛에서 전기자석파를 방사하며 하늘을 난다.
Description (en, shield): It subsists on electricity. As Magnemite flies, it emits electromagnetic waves from the units on each side of its body.
Description (en, legends-arceus): A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

Description (en, red): Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

Description (en, gold): Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

Description (en, crystal): When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.
Description (en, ruby): MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this POKéMON.
Description (en, sapphire): MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and precision instruments. Because of this, it is said that some towns warn people to keep this POKéMON inside a POKé BALL.
Description (en, emerald): It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
Description (en, firered): A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
Description (en, leafgreen): Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

Description (en, platinum): Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
Description (en, soulsilver): The MAGNEMITE are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.
Description (en, black-2): The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.
Description (ko, x): 다수의 코일이 연결되어 강력한 자기장과 높은 전압을 방사한다.

Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강한 자력으로 기계를 망가트리기 때문에 큰 마을에서는 사이렌을 울려 레어코일의 대량 발생을 알린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this Pokémon.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 강력한 자기장이 정밀 기계를 망가트리기 때문에 몬스터볼에 넣어 두지 않으면 주의를 받는 마을도 있다고 한다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and precision instruments. Because of this, it is said that some towns warn people to keep this Pokémon inside a Poké Ball.
Description (ko, sun): 연결할 때 3마리의 코일의 뇌도 하나로 연결된다. 3배로 똑똑해지지는 않는다.
Description (en, sun): When three Magnemite link together, their brains also become one. They do not become three times more intelligent.
Description (ko, moon): 거의 코일의 3배의 전력이다. 태양의 흑점이 많을 때 어찌 된 일인지 대량 발생한다.
Description (en, moon): It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 정체 모를 전파를 발신하기 때문에 레어코일이 사는 곳에는 정밀 기기가 고장 난다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 비구름이 생기면 높은 곳에 모여든다. 번개가 치기를 기다리는 것이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): When rain clouds form, many Magneton gather in high places to wait for lightning to strike.

Description (en, sword): This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.
Description (ko, shield): 강한 자력을 끊임없이 발산한다. 레어코일이 접근하면 대부분의 컴퓨터에 이상 현상이 발생한다.
Description (en, shield): This Pokémon is constantly putting out a powerful magnetic force. Most computers go haywire when a Magneton approaches.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: farfetchd

Name (ko): 파오리
Name (en): Farfetch’d
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: brown
shape: wings
Description (en, red): The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
Description (en, yellow): Lives where reedy plants grow. They are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.
Description (en, gold): If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.
Description (en, silver): If it eats the plant stick it carries as emer­ gency rations, it runs off in search of a new stick.
Description (en, crystal): In order to pre­ vent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these POKéMON.
Description (en, ruby): FARFETCH’D is always seen with a stick from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON has been known to fight with others over sticks.
Description (en, emerald): It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.
Description (en, firered): It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
Description (en, leafgreen): The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.
Description (en, diamond): It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
Description (en, heartgold): If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.
Description (en, soulsilver): If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.
Description (ko, x): 가지고 있는 파 줄기는 소중한 무기이기도 하며 칼을 휘두르듯 다양한 것을 자를 수 있다.
Description (ko, y): 자신의 둥지를 만들기 위해서 식물의 줄기 하나를 항상 들고 걷는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 가지고 있는 식물의 줄기에도 좋은 것과 그렇지 않은 것이 있는 듯하여 파오리들이 줄기를 둘러싸고 싸우는 일도 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Farfetch’d is always seen with a stalk from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good stalks and bad stalks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over stalks.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 줄기가 자라는 곳에 산다. 이상하게 수도 적어서 파오리의 수도 줄고 있는 듯하다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought their numbers are decreasing.
Description (ko, sword): 날개로 쥐고 있는 파 줄기를 칼처럼 휘둘러 상대를 베어버린다. 몹시 허기질 때는 먹기도 한다.
Description (en, sword): The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
Description (ko, shield): 식물의 줄기로 싸운다. 줄기를 휘두르는 방식에 따라 몇 종류의 유파가 있는 듯하다.
Description (en, shield): They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

document.body:

habitat: sea
color: white
shape: fish

Description (en, yellow): Loves freezing cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid cli­ mate of around 14F degrees.

Description (en, ruby): SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
Description (en, emerald): SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
Description (en, firered): Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (en, leafgreen): The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.
Description (en, diamond): A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
Description (en, heartgold): Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.
Description (en, black-2): The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.
Description (ko, x): 빙산에 사는 포켓몬이다. 머리의 뾰족하게 돌출된 부분으로 얼음을 깨고 바다를 헤엄친다.
Description (ko, y): 하늘색의 털로 뒤덮인 피부는 두껍고 튼튼하다. 영하 40도라도 활동할 수 있다.
Description (en, y): Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 얼음으로 뒤덮인 바다에서 먹이를 잡는다. 숨을 쉴 때는 머리의 돌출된 부분으로 얼음을 깨고 바다 밖으로 얼굴을 내민다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 차가운 바다에서만 산다고 추정되었다. 알로라에 나타나는 이유를 알 수 없다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 두꺼운 지방 덕분에 추운 바다는 문제없지만 따뜻한 바다에서 쉽게 지친다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 얼어붙을 정도로 추운 곳을 좋아한다. 영하 10도 정도의 물속에서 기분 좋게 헤엄친다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

document.body:

habitat: sea
color: white
shape: fish
Description (en, red): Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
Description (en, yellow): Its entire body is a snowy-white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
Description (en, gold): Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
Description (en, silver): It loves frigid seas with ice floes. It uses its long tail to change swimming direction quickly.
Description (en, crystal): It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.
Description (en, ruby): DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
Description (en, emerald): It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

Description (en, diamond): In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

Description (ko, x): 전신이 새하얀 털로 뒤덮여 있다. 추위에 강해서 오히려 추울수록 힘이 넘쳐 난다.
Description (ko, y): 몸은 물의 저항이 적은 유선형이다. 추워질수록 기운이 난다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 차가운 얼음 위에서 자는 것을 매우 좋아한다. 옛날에 빙산에서 자는 모습을 본 뱃사람이 인어로 착각했다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 8노트의 속도로 바다를 헤엄쳐 먹이가 되는 포켓몬을 찾는다. 특히 약어리를 매우 좋아한다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It’s especially fond of Wishiwashi.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 식사 후에는 모래 해변에서 일광욕을 하고 있다. 체온을 높여서 소화를 돕기 위함이다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 온몸이 눈처럼 새하얗다. 추위에 강해 얼음이 떠 있는 바다도 기운차게 헤엄쳐 다닌다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

document.title: grimer — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: grimer
ID: 88
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 질퍽이
Name (en): Grimer
generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: purple
shape: arms
Description (en, red): Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
Description (en, yellow): Made of hardened sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
Description (en, gold): As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
Description (en, silver): Wherever GRIMER has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.
Description (en, crystal): When two of these POKéMON's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
Description (en, ruby): GRIMER’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This POKéMON enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
Description (en, sapphire): GRIMER emerged from the sludge that settled on a polluted seabed. This POKéMON loves anything filthy. It constantly leaks a horribly germ- infested fluid from all over its body.
Description (en, emerald): Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER’s favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.
Description (en, firered): Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.
Description (en, leafgreen): Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
Description (en, diamond): It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
Description (en, heartgold): As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
Description (en, black-2): Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.
Description (ko, x): 달로부터의 X선을 쬔 오물이 질퍽이로 변화했다. 더러운 것을 좋아한다.
Description (en, x): Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.
Description (ko, y): 지저분한 곳에 모습을 드러낸다. 공장에서 내보내는 오물 폐수를 마시며 살고 있다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 흐물흐물 물렁물렁한 몸은 아무리 좁은 틈이라도 파고들어 갈 수 있다. 하수관에 들어가 지저분한 물을 마신다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Grimer’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokémon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 오염된 해저의 진흙에서 태어났다. 더러운 것을 매우 좋아해서 몸 전체에서 세균 범벅인 액체가 흘러나오고 있다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): Grimer emerged from the sludge that settled on a polluted seabed. This Pokémon loves anything filthy. It constantly leaks a horribly germ-infested fluid from all over its body.
Description (ko, sun): 공장에서 흘러나오는 오물 폐수가 주요 먹이다. 최근에는 수가 줄어들고 있다.
Description (en, sun): Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon’s numbers have been decreasing in recent years.
Description (ko, moon): 달의 엑스선을 쬔 진흙이 변화하여 태어났다. 몸의 세균이 줄어들면 죽는다.
Description (en, moon): It was born from sludge transformed by exposure to X-rays from the moon. When its internal load of germs decreases, it dies.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 바다 밑의 진흙에서 태어났다. 청결한 장소에서는 체내의 세균이 증식되지 않아 죽어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can’t multiply, and it dies.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 최근에는 공장에서 나오는 폐수가 깨끗해서 먹이가 없다. 곧 멸종될 것이라고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They’re said to be on the verge of extinction.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 진흙이 뭉쳐져서 태어났다. 악취 때문에 건드릴 엄두가 안 나고 지나간 자리에는 풀 한 포기 나지 않는다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

document.title: muk — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: muk
ID: 89
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 질뻐기
Name (en): Muk
generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: purple
shape: arms
Description (en, red): Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
Description (en, yellow): Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration, it lost its sense of smell.
Description (en, gold): They love to gath­ er in smelly areas where sludge ac­ cumulates, making the stench around them worse.
Description (en, silver): Its body is made of a powerful poi­ son. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.
Description (en, crystal): As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.
Description (en, ruby): From MUK’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this POKéMON’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
Description (en, sapphire): This POKéMON’s favorite food is anything that is repugnantly filthy. In dirty towns where people think nothing of throwing away litter on the streets, MUK are certain to gather.
Description (en, emerald): It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.
Description (en, firered): It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.
Description (en, diamond): A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
Description (en, heartgold): They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.
Description (en, black-2): It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.
Description (ko, x): 진흙이 쌓여 악취가 나는 장소를 좋아해서 모여들기 때문에 주변은 더욱 악취가 난다.
Description (ko, y): 몸에서 맹독의 체액이 배어 나오고 있다. 그 액에 스친 초목은 순식간에 시든다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 몸에서 배어 나오는 체액은 코를 찌를 정도로 강렬한 냄새를 뿜는다. 한 방울로 수영장의 물이 탁해지고 냄새가 난다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): From Muk’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this Pokémon’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
Description (ko, alpha-sapphire): 더러운 것을 매우 좋아해서 쓰레기를 길가에 버릴 것 같은 사람이 사는 마을에는 질뻐기가 모여든다.
Description (en, alpha-sapphire): This Pokémon’s favorite food is anything that is repugnantly filthy. In dirty towns where people think nothing of throwing away litter on the streets, Muk are certain to gather.
Description (ko, sun): 코를 찌를 정도로 지독한 냄새가 난다. 하지만 오히려 그 냄새가 좋다는 질뻐기 마니아도 일부 존재한다.
Description (en, sun): The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that’s a good thing.
Description (ko, moon): 환경이 정비된 최근에는 좀처럼 모습을 볼 수 없게 되었다. 언젠가는 멸종될 것이라고 전해진다.
Description (en, moon): After recent environmental improvements, this Pokémon is now hardly seen at all. People speculate that it may go extinct at some point.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 먹이가 줄어들어 개체 수가 격감했다. 멸종을 방지하기 위해 인공 진흙 연못을 만들기 시작했다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 병원균을 흩뿌리기 때문에 제거를 거듭한 결과 수가 급격히 줄어들었다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Because they scatter germs everywhere, they’ve long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 악취가 심하다! 기절할 정도로 강렬하지만 질뻐기는 코가 퇴화해서 냄새를 맡지 못한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: shellder
ID: 90
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 셀러
Name (en): Shellder
generation: generation-i
habitat: sea
color: purple
shape: ball
Description (en, red): Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
Description (en, yellow): The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.
Description (en, gold): It swims facing backward by open­ ing and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
Description (en, silver): Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.
Description (en, crystal): Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.
Description (en, ruby): At night, this POKéMON uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
Description (en, emerald): At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
Description (en, firered): It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
Description (en, diamond): It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
Description (en, heartgold): It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
Description (ko, x): 단단한 껍데기는 어떤 공격도 튕겨낸다. 껍데기를 벌리고 있을 때 안쪽을 공격당하는 것에는 약하다.
Description (ko, y): 껍데기로 물어 공격하는 것은 부드러운 안쪽이 드러나므로 궁지에 몰렸을 때 쓰는 수단이다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 밤이 되면 큰 혀로 해저의 모래에 구멍을 뚫고 그 안에서 잔다. 혀를 내민 채로 껍질을 닫고 잠든다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, Shellder closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
Description (ko, sun): 껍질의 강도는 다이아몬드보다 높다. 옛날 사람은 껍질을 모아서 방패를 만들었었다.
Description (en, sun): The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.
Description (ko, moon): 항상 내밀고 있는 혀를 능숙히 사용하여 해저의 모래를 파내 먹이를 찾는다.
Description (en, moon): This Pokémon’s tongue is always hanging out. It uses its tongue with great dexterity to dig up sand from the seabed in its search for food.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 껍질 안에 쌓인 모래는 이윽고 진주가 되지만 방해가 되기 때문에 뱉어 버린다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): The sand that accumulates inside its shell eventually becomes a pearl. But the pearl gets in the way, so it spits it out and discards it.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 껍질을 닫고 있을 때도 혀만은 내밀고 있다. 세게 잡아당기면 놀라서 껍질을 연다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Even when its shell is closed, its tongue still hangs out. If you give its tongue a good yank, the shock will cause Shellder to open its shell.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 어떤 공격에도 견디는 단단한 껍질을 가졌지만 열면 부드러운 몸이 드러난다.
Description (ko, sword): 2개의 껍질을 여닫아서 뒤쪽으로 헤엄친다. 그 스피드는 제법 빠르다.
Description (ko, shield): 단단한 껍데기는 어떤 공격도 튕겨낸다. 껍데기를 열었을 때 안쪽을 공격당하는 것에는 약하다.

habitat: sea
color: purple

Description (en, sun): Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

Description (en, moon): Excavation of the tombs of ancient hunting tribes has turned up many spears tipped with spikes that had fallen off this Pokémon’s shell.

Description (ko, shield): 한번 껍질을 닫아버리면 어떤 괴력의 소유자도 여는 것은 불가능하다.

document.title: gastly — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: gastly
ID: 92
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고오스
Name (en): Gastly
generation: generation-i
habitat: cave
color: purple
shape: ball
Description (en, red): Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
Description (en, yellow): Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape as it appears to be made of a gas.
Description (en, gold): With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
Description (en, silver): Its thin body is made of gas. It can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
Description (en, crystal): It wraps its op­ ponent in its gas- like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
Description (en, ruby): GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this POKéMON cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
Description (en, emerald): When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY’s gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
Description (en, firered): A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.
Description (en, diamond): This Pokémon’s body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.
Description (en, pearl): A Pokémon born from poison gases. It defeats even the largest foes by enveloping them in gas.
Description (en, platinum): Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
Description (ko, x): 가스로 만들어진 몸은 어떠한 크기의 상대라도 둘러싸서 숨을 못 쉬게 한다.
Description (ko, y): 가스에서 태어난 생명체다. 독을 포함한 가스로 된 몸에 둘러싸이면 누구든지 기절한다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 강풍을 맞으면 가스로 된 몸은 금세 날려져서 작아진다. 바람을 피해 고오스가 처마 밑에 모인다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Gastly is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
Description (ko, sun): 폐허가 된 건물에 수상한 빛이 비친다면 그곳에 고오스가 살고 있다.
Description (en, sun): Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.
Description (ko, moon): 그 모습은 거의 보이지 않지만 고오스가 근처에 나타나면 희미하게 달콤한 향기가 난다.
Description (en, moon): Although Gastly is barely visible, when it’s near, a faint sweet smell lingers.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 무덤에서 발생한 가스에 원념이 머물러 이윽고 포켓몬이 되었다고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It’s said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 몸의 95퍼센트는 독가스다. 남은 5퍼센트는 독가스에 의해 죽은 이들의 영혼이라고 전해진다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Poisonous gas comprises 95% of its body. It’s said that the remaining 5% is made up of the souls of those who died from the gas.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 오래되어 아무도 살지 않는 건물에 나타나는 듯하다. 형태는 모호하고 가스 같다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape, as it appears to be made of a gas.
Description (ko, sword): 가스에서 태어난 생명체다. 독을 포함한 가스의 몸에 둘러싸이면 누구든지 기절한다.
Description (ko, shield): 몸은 옅은 가스로 되어 있어 어디든지 숨어들어 가지만 바람이 불면 날아가 버린다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

document.title: haunter — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: haunter
ID: 93
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 고우스트
Name (en): Haunter
generation: generation-i
habitat: cave
color: purple
shape: arms
Description (en, red): Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
Description (en, yellow): By licking, it saps the victim's life. It causes shaking that won't stop until the victim's demise.
Description (en, gold): In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
Description (en, silver): Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death even­ tually comes.
Description (en, crystal): It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of the next living thing that wanders close by.
Description (en, ruby): HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
Description (en, emerald): If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don’t approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
Description (en, firered): If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.
Description (en, leafgreen): Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.
Description (en, diamond): It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
Description (en, pearl): It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim’s life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.
Description (en, platinum): It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
Description (en, soulsilver): Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
Description (ko, x): 어둠 속에서 아무도 없는데도 누군가가 보고 있다는 느낌이 들면 그곳에 고우스트가 있는 것이다.
Description (en, x): If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
Description (ko, y): 가스로 된 혓바닥으로 핥이게 되면 영혼을 빼앗겨 버린다. 어둠에 숨어 먹이를 노린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 어둠 속에서 나타나는 고우스트가 손짓으로 불러도 절대 가까이 가면 안 된다. 날름 핥아져 생명을 빨린다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Haunter is a dangerous Pokémon. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
Description (ko, sun): 어둠 속에서 인간을 노린다. 차가운 혀로 핥으면 날이 갈수록 약해져 죽음에 이른다.
Description (en, sun): It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.
Description (ko, moon): 빛을 무서워하고 어둠을 좋아한다. 밤중에도 밝은 도시에서는 멸종 위기에 처해있다고 전해진다.
Description (en, moon): It fears the light and revels in the dark. It may be on the verge of extinction in cities that stay brightly lit at night.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 달이 뜨지 않은 밤. 고우스트는 저주할 상대를 찾기 때문에 나다니지 않는 것이 좋다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it’s best not to go out walking around.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 슬픈 기분이 드는 밤에는 혼자 밖에 나가면 위험하다. 고우스트에게 붙잡혀 집에 돌아갈 수 없게 된다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It’s dangerous to go outside alone on nights when you’re feeling sad. Haunter will catch you, and you won’t be able to go back home.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 핥아서 상대의 생명을 흡수한다. 상대는 몸을 계속 벌벌 떨다가 결국에는 죽음에 이른다고 한다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): By licking, it saps the victim’s life. It causes shaking that won’t stop until the victim’s demise.
Description (ko, sword): 가스로 된 혀에 닿게 되면 몸의 떨림이 멈추지 않게 되어 결국에는 죽음에 이른다고 전해진다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

document.title: gengar — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: gengar
ID: 94
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 팬텀
Name (en): Gengar
generation: generation-i
habitat: cave
color: purple
shape: upright
Description (en, red): Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
Description (en, yellow): A GENGAR is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
Description (en, gold): It steals heat from its surround­ ings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
Description (en, silver): To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.
Description (en, crystal): Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
Description (en, ruby): Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
Description (en, emerald): Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
Description (en, firered): It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.
Description (en, leafgreen): On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be GENGAR’s doing.
Description (en, diamond): It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.
Description (en, pearl): Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms, it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life force.
Description (en, platinum): The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.
Description (en, heartgold): It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
Description (en, soulsilver): To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.
Description (en, black): The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
Description (ko, x): 그림자에 모습을 숨긴다. 팬텀이 숨어 있는 방은 온도가 5도 내려간다고 전해진다.
Description (en, x): It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
Description (ko, y): 한밤중 사람의 그림자에 숨어들어 조금씩 체온을 뺏는다. 숨어들면 한기가 멈추지 않는다.
Description (en, y): Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 한밤중 가로등 빛에 생겨난 그림자가 자신을 앞질러 가는 것은 팬텀이 그림자인 척하며 뛰어가기 때문이다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
Description (ko, sun): 갑자기 졸음이 쏟아진다면 팬텀이 노리고 있다는 증거다. 도망갈 방법은 없으니 포기하자.
Description (en, sun): Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.
Description (ko, moon): 인간의 목숨을 노리는 이유는 팬텀이 인간의 비참한 말로여서 길동무를 만들기 위해서라고 한다.
Description (en, moon): It apparently wishes for a traveling companion. Since it was once human itself, it tries to create one by taking the lives of other humans.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 못된 아이가 있는 곳에 팬텀이 찾아온다고 하는 이야기는 전 세계에서 들을 수 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 집에 있어도 위험하다. 방구석에 생긴 작은 그림자에 숨어서 먹이를 노리고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): Even your home isn’t safe. Gengar will lurk in whatever dark corner of a room it can find and wait for its chance to catch its prey.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 갑자기 한기를 느꼈다면 팬텀이 가까이 있는 것이다. 어쩌면 저주를 걸지도 모른다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
Description (ko, sword): 보름달이 뜬 밤에 그림자가 멋대로 움직이면서 웃는다면 팬텀의 소행임이 틀림없다.
Description (en, sword): On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.
Description (ko, shield): 산에서 조난하면 목숨을 빼앗기 위해 어둠 속에서 나타난다고 한다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

document.title: onix — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: onix
ID: 95
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 롱스톤
Name (en): Onix
generation: generation-i
habitat: cave
color: gray
shape: squiggle
Description (en, red): As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
Description (en, yellow): Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by DIGLETTs.
Description (en, gold): It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
Description (en, silver): It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its mas­ sive, rugged body.
Description (en, crystal): As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
Description (en, ruby): ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this POKéMON does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
Description (en, emerald): There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
Description (en, firered): It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.
Description (en, leafgreen): As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.
Description (en, diamond): When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
Description (en, pearl): It squirms through the ground using its long and rugged body. It always eats while burrowing.
Description (en, platinum): It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
Description (en, soulsilver): It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
Description (en, black-2): Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.
Description (ko, x): 땅속을 엄청난 기세로 뚫고 나아가며 먹이를 찾는다. 지나간 곳은 디그다의 보금자리가 된다.
Description (en, x): Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
Description (ko, y): 평상시에는 땅속에 살고 있다. 땅속을 시속 80km로 파면서 먹이를 찾는다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 뇌에 자석이 있어서 땅속을 파고 나가도 방향을 틀리지 않는다. 나이를 먹을수록 몸이 둥그스름해진다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
Description (ko, sword): 땅속을 파고들면서 여러 가지 단단한 것들을 집어삼켜서 튼튼한 몸을 만든다.
Description (ko, shield): 크고 튼튼한 몸을 뒤틀고 꼬아서 시속 80km로 힘차게 땅을 파나간다.
Description (en, legends-arceus): This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

document.title: drowzee — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: drowzee
ID: 96
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 슬리프
Name (en): Drowzee
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: yellow
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
Description (en, yellow): If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it has eaten in the past.
Description (en, gold): If you think that you had a good dream, but you can't remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
Description (en, silver): It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.
Description (en, crystal): When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
Description (en, ruby): If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these POKéMON is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
Description (en, emerald): If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
Description (en, firered): A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.
Description (en, leafgreen): Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.
Description (en, diamond): It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
Description (en, heartgold): If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
Description (en, soulsilver): It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.
Description (ko, x): 잠들게 한 뒤 꿈을 먹지만 나쁜 꿈만 먹고 있으면 배탈이 날 때도 있는 것 같다.
Description (ko, y): 즐거운 꿈을 꾸고 있었는데 어떤 꿈인지 생각나지 않을 때는 분명히 슬리프가 꿈을 먹었을 것이다.
Description (en, y): If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 잠들었을 때 너의 코가 근질근질하다면 슬리프가 머리맡에 서서 콧구멍을 통해 꿈을 먹으려고 하는 신호다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
Description (ko, sun): 꿈을 먹으며 살아가는 포켓몬이다. 몽나나 몽얌나와 선조가 같다고 여겨지고 있다.
Description (en, sun): A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.
Description (ko, moon): 특히 즐거운 꿈이 맛있다고 한다. 친해지면 가장 맛있었던 꿈을 보여줄 때도 있다.
Description (en, moon): It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it’s ever eaten.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 레저 시설 근처에서 볼 수 있다. 그날 밤 아이가 꾸는 즐거운 꿈을 노리고 있다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 먹이를 잠들게 해 보고 있는 꿈을 먹는다. 나쁜 꿈은 시큼해서 그다지 즐겨 먹지 않는다고 한다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn’t particularly like eating them.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 언제나 함께 잠들다 보면 가끔 옛날에 먹었던 꿈을 보여줄 때가 있다.
Description (en, lets-go-pikachu): If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

document.title: hypno — PokéAPI pokemon-species
document.body:
PokéAPI resource: pokemon-species
Name: hypno
ID: 97
Scope: generic Pokémon; game-specific entries below retain their original version. Champions applicability is unknown.
Name (ko): 슬리퍼
Name (en): Hypno
generation: generation-i
habitat: grassland
color: yellow
shape: humanoid
Description (en, red): When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
Description (en, yellow): Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
Description (en, gold): When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
Description (en, silver): Always holding a pendulum that it rocks at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in any­ one nearby.
Description (en, crystal): The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.
Description (en, ruby): HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this POKéMON searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
Description (en, emerald): The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO’s hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
Description (en, firered): It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
Description (en, diamond): Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
Description (en, soulsilver): Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
Description (ko, x): 추 같은 것을 들고 다닌다. 어린아이에게 최면술을 걸어 어딘가로 데려가 버린 사건이 있었다.
Description (ko, y): 눈앞에서 추를 흔들면 방금 깨어난 사람도 3초 후에는 잠들어 버린다.
Description (ko, omega-ruby): 손에 쥐고 있는 추의 움직임과 반짝임이 상대를 깊은 최면 상태에 빠트린다. 먹이를 찾으며 추를 손질하고 있다.
Description (en, omega-ruby): Hypno holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this Pokémon searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
Description (ko, sun): 상당히 위험한 포켓몬이지만 편안한 잠을 원하는 사람들에게는 구세주로 불리고 있다.
Description (en, sun): While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.
Description (ko, moon): 마주친 자를 일단 잠들게 해 그 꿈을 맛본다. 좋은 꿈을 꾸고 있다면 그대로 데리고 간다.
Description (en, moon): As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.
Description (ko, ultra-sun): 알로라에서 사는 슬리퍼의 타깃은 주로 자말라다. 사람은 그다지 피해를 입지 않는다.
Description (en, ultra-sun): In Alola, Komala is Hypno’s main target. It rarely harms people.
Description (ko, ultra-moon): 밤에 잠들지 못하는 사람을 위해 병원에서 의사를 도와주는 슬리퍼도 있다.
Description (en, ultra-moon): There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can’t sleep at night in hospitals.
Description (ko, lets-go-pikachu): 우연히 마주쳤을 때 다른 곳으로 눈을 돌리지 않으면 위험하다. 손에 든 추로 잠재워 버린다.

generation: generation-i
habitat: urban
color: red
shape: ball
Description (en, red): Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
Description (en, yellow): It is said to camouflage itself as a POKé BALL. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
Description (en, gold): It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
Description (en, silver): It was discovered when POKé BALLS were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
Description (en, crystal): During the study of this POKéMON, it was discovered that its compo­ nents are not found in nature.
Description (en, ruby): VOLTORB was first sighted at a company that manufactures POKé BALLS. The link between that sighting and the fact that this POKéMON looks very similar to a POKé BALL remains a mystery.
Description (en, sapphire): VOLTORB is extremely sensitive - it explodes at the slightest of shocks. It is rumored that it was first created when a POKé BALL was exposed to a powerful pulse of energy.
Description (en, emerald): It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.
Description (en, firered): A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.
Description (en, leafgreen): Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, it has zapped many people.
